store_data.about_the_game:
Kiosk Hustle is a first-person shop management simulator about running a small roadside kiosk in a rough neighborhood.

Start with almost nothing, search the local flea market for cheap goods, bring supplies back to your kiosk, open crates, stock the shelves, and try to make enough money to survive another day.

BUY LOW, SELL HIGH

Visit the flea market and search for useful products, supply crates, equipment, and rare finds.

Every purchase is a risk. Some crates may contain valuable goods, while others may barely cover their cost.

RUN YOUR OWN KIOSK

Arrange products on the shelves, keep track of your stock, serve customers, and choose how much to charge for every item.

Fair prices keep customers happy.

High prices may scare them away.

Ridiculous prices might occasionally attract someone with more money than common sense.

DEAL WITH STRANGE CUSTOMERS

Not every visitor is here for a normal purchase.

Meet unusual customers, suspicious locals, lost visitors, thieves, troublemakers, and people who seem to have wandered into the wrong kiosk.

Some will buy.

Some will complain.

Some may need to be chased away with a mop.

SURVIVE EACH DAY

Rent, supplies, equipment, and bad decisions all cost money.

Manage your cash carefully, avoid falling too far into debt, and make enough profit to keep the business alive.

If your money drops below zero, you will have limited time to recover before everything falls apart.

EXPAND YOUR BUSINESS

Order new equipment, unlock additional products, experiment with production stations, prepare fermented drinks, and improve the way your kiosk operates.

Use the old laptop to manage prices, order equipment, and keep track of your growing business.

A SMALL BUSINESS WITH BIG PROBLEMS

Kiosk Hustle combines shop management, exploration, trading, physical interactions, and absurd neighborhood events.

Your kiosk may be small, but every day can turn into a completely different disaster.

store_data.about_the_game:
Raise a guild, not just a single hero


The dead walk once more, and an ancient bell tolls beneath the earth. Take command of a fallen expedition guild, gather unproven adventurers, and hunt the calamity awakening below five sealed gates.

There is no single chosen hero in this story. Every expedition—and every adventurer who makes it home—builds the strength your guild needs to descend farther.

Plan short, perilous expeditions


The expedition board offers dungeons with different risks and rewards. Choose who to send, then explore a procedurally generated top-down grid where limited SP, rising encounter danger, and the road home all matter.

Reaching the exit is not enough. Defeat the elite party guarding the final path to complete the expedition. Press deeper for greater rewards, or withdraw while your party still has the strength to return.

Command classic row-based turn-based battles


Read formation, turn order, remaining SP, and enemy roles before you act. Guardians hold the front, damage dealers exploit openings, healers support the back line, and controlling enemies disrupt your plans.

More than 70 monsters and region-specific encounters await across six regions and eighteen expedition sites. Common foes wear down your resources; elites and gate bosses test the limits of the party you have built.

Build multiple parties—and keep them moving


Heroes need time to recover after an expedition. One powerful team cannot solve every problem. Raise second and third parties to take over while veterans rest, then reshape your lineup for the traits of the next dungeon.

  • A roster of adventurers with distinct classes and combat roles
  • Hundreds of skills and equipment options for character builds
  • Dungeon traits that alter both risk and reward
  • In-run ability and equipment drafts alongside permanent guild progression
  • A standard mode focused on roster management without permanent loss
  • A hard mode where fallen adventurers are gone for good

Uncover the truth beneath five gates


Descend from flooded crypts through echoing mines, a fogbound labyrinth, ember warrens, and a frozen abyss toward the Sunless Throne. Each broken gate reveals records of a dead kingdom through full-screen story scenes.

But not every victory saves the world. As the seals around the throne collapse, the power below awakens. Prepare every party in your guild to finish what you have begun.

store_data.about_the_game:
🏰 Castle Building & Empire Progression

  • Advanced Architecture: Build and upgrade 62 distinct buildings.

  • Lineage Systems: Specialize your kingdom across 8 Lineage Building Trees.

  • Empire Dominion: Unlock powerful global bonuses that buff your entire empire.

⚔️ Army Customization

  • Diverse Roster: Recruit from 10 distinct races and 164 unique units.

  • Level Progression: Units now unlock their powerful first skill at Level 2.

  • Hero Talents: Deepen your commander strategy with a 20x4 Hero Talent matrix.

  • Massive Skill Pool: Mix, match, and counter opponents using over 200 unique skills.

💎 Loot, Gear, & Progression Loops

  • Infinite Item Pool: Over 108 gear templates spanning Tier 1 to Tier 3 with massive randomized stat pools.

  • Blacksmithing: Upgrade and enchant your gear to maximize your squad's power.

  • Book of Champions: Make your champions collection.

  • Quest System: Complete dynamic objectives for continuous rewards.

🗺️ Enhanced PvE Combat & Farming

  • Dynamic World: Explore 118 adaptable unique location sites featuring completely reworked drop pools.

  • Monster Summons: Defeating any mob gives a tactical chance to drop its own unique unit summon scroll.

  • Flexible Battle Modes: Fight enemy squads solo in PvE using either tactical Manual Combat or high-speed Auto Combat.

  • Enhanced Visuals: Fully upgraded combat experience with fresh visual effects and unique weapon/skill sounds.

🏆 Competitive PvP, Guilds, & Leaderboards

  • Versatile Arena: Compete in Ranked and Unranked PvP.

  • Combat Control: Clash in real-time Manual Combat or test your team's AI in Auto vs. Player squad defense.

  • Seasonal Ladders: Compete in global seasons tracked by XP Gained, Global Power, Guild Ranking, and PvP Rank.

🚀 Coming Next (Future Road Map)

  • Adventure Game Mode: Team up with guildmates to explore massive cooperative dungeon maps.

  • RPG Dungeon Crawler: Scale down to a smaller squad and dive into first-person, retro-style RPG exploration.

  • MOBA PvP Arena: Engage in fast-paced 3v3 real-time map movement paired with tactical turn-based strategy (TBS) squad fights.

  • Daily Tower Conquest: Test your endurance daily against escalating floors of challenging enemy compositions.

store_data.about_the_game:
The caverns are never the same twice

Beneath the old world, a wound in the earth swallows everyone brave — or foolish — enough to enter. Take up a class, step through the mouth of the cave, and descend floor by floor into a dark-fantasy roguelite where every run carves a new path through shifting biomes.

Every descent starts fresh

You enter with nothing but your class and your wits. Weapons, armour, reagents and gold are found — and lost — in the dark. Fall, and the caverns keep your gear... but the rare artifacts you drag back to the surface are yours forever, quietly making the next adventurer stronger.

Key Features

  • Roguelite descent — procedurally generated floors across distinct biomes; no two runs alike.
  • Pick your class — warrior, mage, rogue or alchemist, each with its own gear, skills and rhythm.
  • Spells & a skill tree — hurl firebolts, frost novas and chain lightning, and spend hard-won points to grow a build all your own.
  • Tier-scaled combat — monsters grow with the depths you reach, not a fixed clock; the deep floors are a real test.
  • Permanent artifacts — recover relics that persist between runs and unlock lasting power.
  • Loot and craft — gather reagents, brew potions, and forge your build from whatever the caverns give you.
  • A town to call home — return to the surface to spend gold, take on villager quests, and fill the Artifact Museum.
  • One more floor — permadeath runs tuned so a skilled delver reaches the depths, and the best keep chasing them.

How deep will you go?

store_data.about_the_game:
ROBOTEKA is a unique robot fighting action game where you battle using only left and right weight shifts and a turn button.

By simplifying the concepts of timing and distance, the game lets anyone enjoy the strategic depth of martial arts through intuitive controls.

Features

Simple Controls, Deep Combat

  • Experience deep and rewarding combat using only left and right weight shifts and a turn button.

  • Victory depends on timing and distance. Dodge enemy attacks at the last possible moment, then strike from the perfect range to unleash maximum power.

  • Combine the turn button with your attacks to perform spinning kicks, or activate MIKIRI Mode by perfectly reading an opponent's attack to deal massive damage. Despite its simple controls, the combat offers a variety of satisfying techniques.

  • ROBOTEKA is designed to capture the essence of martial arts—timing and distance—in an intuitive and accessible gameplay system.

Multiple Fighting Styles and Diverse Enemies

  • Complete stage missions to unlock a variety of punches and kicks, allowing you to customize your fighting style.

  • Every enemy has different attack timings and techniques. Choose the moves that best suit your strategy and overcome each challenge.

World

  • Explore a near-future world presented with detailed pixel art and a sense of depth across seven handcrafted stages.

  • Enjoy an original soundtrack created to complement the game's unique atmosphere.

Additional Information

  • Single-player

  • 7 stages

  • Controller support

  • Includes the complete original soundtrack as bonus content.

4977210.name: Stop The Fire: Apprentice Water Wizard

store_data.about_the_game:
Story

It's your very first day as an Apprentice Water Wizard.

Before you even have time to settle in, a mysterious wildfire erupts across the world. Every experienced wizard has already been dispatched, leaving only one person behind...

You.

Grab your wand and spellbook, extinguish the spreading flames, and uncover the truth behind the disaster.

Gameplay: Extinguish Every Fire

Your mission is simple:

Put out every fire.

From burning forests and blazing houses to smoldering streets, the flames have spread farther than anyone imagined. Rescue innocent townsfolk, save frightened woodland creatures, and restore the world one spell at a time.

Somewhere behind the catastrophe, an unseen force is pulling the strings. As the fire fades, so will the mystery.

Learn New Magic

Experience firefighting through first-person spellcasting.

Aim at the flames and cast powerful spells to extinguish the fire. As you restore the world, you'll earn Skill Points that can be used to unlock new abilities and expand your magical arsenal.

Master abilities such as:

  • Rainfall Spells to extinguish large areas at once

  • Wind Magic to reach difficult locations

  • Powerful Combo Spells with unique effects

Discover, combine, and master an ever-growing collection of spells to extinguish the impossible.

Restore a Living World

Every area you save comes back to life.

Burned landscapes gradually recover, special environmental animations appear, and the soundtrack evolves as the world heals. Friendly forest spirits may even join your firefighting efforts, rewarding your progress with delightful surprises.

There's always something new waiting to be restored.

Play Your Way

Whether you carefully extinguish every flame or rush to unlock the most powerful spells, your journey is yours to shape.

Estimated playtime: 4 to 8 hours, depending on your playstyle and spell choices.

4977250.name: One Thought Immortal / 一念修仙

store_data.about_the_game:
One thought to immortal, one thought to demon.

You've read a hundred cultivation novels. Now live one — a full cultivator's life, from the day the testing stone reads your spirit root to the day you ascend.

Why you'll love it

🧬 It all begins with your spirit root — Step onto the testing stone and learn your fate: a single-element root cultivates a thousand miles a day, while a mixed five-element root walks the hardest, most rewarding path. Your innate gift shapes the entire run.

🗺️ A cultivation world that is yours — Every world is a hand-painted-style tile map, procedurally generated — righteous and demonic sects, cities, markets, dens, ancient battlefields and secret realms. Or open the Map Atelier and build your own continent: place every sect, every city, every secret realm exactly where you dreamed it.

⚡ From Qi Refining to Ascension — Meditate, enter seclusion, and defy heaven's tribulation lightning at every breakthrough: Qi Refining, Foundation, Golden Core, Nascent Soul, Spirit Severing — all the way to ascension. Lifespan ticks in real time; every year in seclusion is a year closer to your final calamity.

🏯 A real sect career — Start as an odd-jobs disciple and climb: outer, inner, core disciple, elder — even sect master. Run sect missions for contribution points, exchange them for techniques in the Scripture Pavilion, draw a monthly stipend, and study alchemy, forging and talismans across the sect's many peaks.

💞 Friends, rivals, and a dao companion — Every fellow disciple has a name, a temperament and a story. Chat them up, give gifts they actually like, adventure together — and when affection runs deep, confess and take a dao companion (they may refuse!). Cross the wrong cultivator and gain a nemesis who hunts you for years. Exchange jade slips to keep friends one message away.

💰 Fortuitous encounters everywhere — Delve free-roaming secret realms, loot storage bags off defeated foes and reveal treasures piece by piece, raid beast dens, flip goods between city markets, splurge at live auctions against AI bidders, and sip tea in the teahouse to hear which secret realm just opened. Equip a natal artifact and grow your hoard.

🧓 New to cultivation? Ask Grandpa Ring — A guardian spirit in your ring answers questions and nudges you along, a built-in cultivation encyclopedia explains every realm, herb and artifact, and an achievement wall of medals marks every first — your first beast slain, the day you reached Foundation Establishment.

🎲 Fall, reincarnate, ascend — A turn-based roguelite: death is permanent, but your Dao-insight carries into the next life as meta-progression. No two runs are alike — until at last, you ascend.

What you can do

  • Explore a procedural tile world map — or design your own in the built-in Map Atelier (terrain, rivers, roads, sects, cities, secret realms; import/export maps)

  • Join sects of named NPCs with traits, relationships and ranks; climb from odd-jobs disciple to elder and beyond

  • Fight turn-based battles with techniques, spells, talismans, a natal artifact, equipment and status effects

  • Cultivate, enter seclusion, and survive heaven-defying tribulations under real-time lifespan pressure

  • Brew pills in the alchemy room, forge artifacts on the Skyworks Peak, buy talismans at market

  • Delve free-roaming secret realms, raid beast dens and bandit camps, scavenge ancient battlefields, gamble on black-market blind boxes

  • Bid at live auctions against AI rivals; flip goods between city markets; hear rumors in the teahouse

  • Befriend, gift, party up, court a dao companion — or make a lifelong nemesis; trade jade slips with fellow cultivators

  • Learn as you play with Grandpa Ring's guidance, the in-game encyclopedia, and a medal wall of achievements

  • Die, reincarnate with Dao-insight meta-progression, and chase ascension across many lives

Built for

Readers of xianxia / cultivation novels who want to live that life themselves — test your spirit root, join a sect, chase fortuitous encounters, and ascend. Also for roguelite and turn-based RPG players who love deep, systemic games: fans of Amazing Cultivation Simulator, Slay the Spire and Loop Hero.

Languages & features

Playable in English, Simplified Chinese and Traditional Chinese. Fully offline, single-player — all saves and progress stay on your device.

4977360.name: Lowmoor Idle RPG: An Adventurer's Chronicle

store_data.about_the_game:
Sold matted tail x3 for 9 gold pieces. "The Guild buys by weight," says Master Pell. "The Guild has always bought by weight."

A zero-player RPG, after Progress Quest

Lowmoor is written in the voice of the old adventure modules. You enrol at the Adventurers' Guild of Mereward, sign the Roll, and keep the chronicle while your adventurer hunts, gains rank, hauls trophies to market, commissions better steel, and descends. Six floors below the town a dragon sleeps upon its hoard, and something older waits below the dragon.

Watch the descent, keep it in the corner of a second monitor, or close it altogether. Time passes in the deep while you are gone, and the Guild renders an account of your absence when you return, capped at four hours.

Your counsel is asked once

Choices arrive as sealed letters from the road. Leave one sealed and it settles itself safely. Break the seal and some go to the dice: a d20 against a difficulty class, rolled in the open.

Five arcs, complete and free from end to end

Arc I, The Way Down, is six floors, a plot told in sealed letters, staged bosses with their own phases, and an ending. The goblin king falls in the first half hour, and the wyrm is an afternoon of leaving it running.

Past the wyrm, Arc II opens the elder stair the dragon's weight kept shut, six deeper floors charted at about a day. Arc III opens under the quarry floor, six halls kept by a mage who has watched the whole descent through a thousand small eyes, charted at about two days. Two arcs wait below those: the offices behind the Court of the Lich, and, past the last door, the debt the Maw was dug to bury.

When an arc closes, the game writes your run out as a page of module prose to copy for whoever asks how the descent went.

What the chronicle holds

Sold matted tail x3 for 9 gold pieces. "The Guild buys by weight," says Master Pell. "The Guild has always bought by weight."

A zero-player RPG, after Progress Quest

Lowmoor is written in the voice of the old adventure modules. You enrol at the Adventurers' Guild of Mereward, sign the Roll, and keep the chronicle while your adventurer hunts, gains rank, hauls trophies to market, commissions better steel, and descends. Six floors below the town a dragon sleeps upon its hoard, and something older waits below the dragon.

Watch the descent, keep it in the corner of a second monitor, or close it altogether. Time passes in the deep while you are gone, and the Guild renders an account of your absence when you return, capped at four hours.

Your counsel is asked once

Choices arrive as sealed letters from the road. Leave one sealed and it settles itself safely. Break the seal and some go to the dice: a d20 against a difficulty class, rolled in the open.

Five arcs, complete and free from end to end

Arc I, The Way Down, is six floors, a plot told in sealed letters, staged bosses with their own phases, and an ending. The goblin king falls in the first half hour, and the wyrm is an afternoon of leaving it running.

Past the wyrm, Arc II opens the elder stair the dragon's weight kept shut, six deeper floors charted at about a day. Arc III opens under the quarry floor, six halls kept by a mage who has watched the whole descent through a thousand small eyes, charted at about two days. Two arcs wait below those: the offices behind the Court of the Lich, and, past the last door, the debt the Maw was dug to bury.

store_data.about_the_game:
Human worth is measured by reputation.

Once, everyone was talking about you. Then they forgot you. When your reputation score dropped to zero, the Ministry of Social Harmony sent you to an isolated container suspended above the ocean.

In this world, visibility is a person's most valuable asset. When attention fades, so does reputation. Those whose reputation reaches zero are removed from society.

RepCell is a choice-driven, text-based dystopian experience about survival, reputation, and the cost of being seen.

Trapped inside a suspended container, you must survive each day while the system monitors your reputation and controls your access to society. Manage your limited supplies, keep yourself alive, respond to events and trending topics, and decide how you will react to the situations presented by the system.

Your choices have consequences.

The decisions you make can change your reputation, affect your physical condition, consume or preserve your limited resources, and influence the events that follow. Some choices may help you regain visibility, while others may push you further into isolation.

Not every consequence is immediately visible. Hidden variables track your behavior throughout the game, quietly shaping events and determining which outcomes become possible. The way you remain silent, respond to treatment, criticize the system, or seek approval can all influence your path.

Every day brings new situations and new decisions. There is no single correct way to play. You must decide what matters more: staying alive, maintaining your reputation, following the system's expectations, or refusing to become what it demands.

Sometimes, the price of becoming visible again is losing a part of yourself.

Features

• Choice-driven dynamic narrative with consequences that carry through your playthrough.

• Multiple endings determined by your decisions, behavior, and hidden variables.

• Reputation, health, and resource management that force you to balance survival against the demands of the system.

• Daily events and changing trends that present new situations and choices.

• Hidden behavioral variables that quietly influence events and create different playthroughs.

• A text-based gameplay experience focused on reading, decision-making, resource management, and consequence.

• A single-player dystopian story where your choices determine how your story ends.

In this world, people are not punished for breaking the law.

They are punished for being forgotten.

store_data.about_the_game:
ROCKET-POWERED VR ARENA ACTION

Rocket Science is a fast-paced VR action sports game where players fly through futuristic arenas, fire rockets, blast opponents, and score goals by launching a physics-driven ball into the opposing team’s goal.

Victory requires more than accurate shooting. Control the ball, defend your goal, collect special powers, manage your ammunition, and work with your teammates to dominate the arena.

FLY, FIRE, AND SCORE

Move freely through the arena using intuitive VR controls. Chase the ball, intercept enemy attacks, and use your rockets to change the direction of the match at any moment.

Rockets can be used to attack opponents, defend your team, and send the ball flying toward the goal.

SPECIAL ROCKET POWERS

Collect powerful abilities during the match and use them at the right moment.

  • Launch magnet rockets that redirect the ball toward the enemy goal.

  • Fire tornado rockets that cause increased damage.

  • Use speed and movement abilities to quickly reposition yourself.

  • Blast opponents to earn points for your team.

SINGLE-PLAYER AND MULTIPLAYER

Play alone against AI-controlled opponents or compete with other players in online multiplayer matches.

Choose your team, enter the arena, and combine offensive and defensive strategies to achieve victory.

KEY FEATURES

  • Fast-paced VR arena combat

  • Physics-driven ball and goal mechanics

  • Rocket-based movement and combat

  • Single-player matches against AI

  • Online multiplayer competition

  • Team-based gameplay

  • Special rocket powers and pickups

  • Multiple AI difficulty levels

  • Stylized futuristic arenas

  • Designed specifically for virtual reality

A VR headset is required.

Tested with Meta Quest 2, Meta Quest 3S, and Meta Quest 3 using a compatible PC VR connection. Other OpenXR-compatible PC VR headsets may work but have not been officially tested.

store_data.about_the_game:
Restore Order To The Last Video Store

The shelves are a disaster, the tapes are everywhere, and the store opens soon. As the new clerk of a retro video store, your job is simple to say and hard to master: pick up every scattered movie tape, read its title, figure out its genre, and place it on the right shelf. No labels, no hints — just your movie instincts. Your survival behind the counter depends not on speed alone, but on how well you read every title that lands in your hands.

Every Tape Belongs Somewhere

From Blood Cabin to Quantum Drift, hundreds of original movies — and their sequels — are waiting to be shelved. Horror, Sci-Fi, Comedy, Romance, Action, Thriller, Fantasy and many more genres each have their own dedicated shelves. Guess right and the shelf glows green. Guess wrong and it flashes red, and the mess wins another round. Some titles are obvious, some will make you stop and think, and a few will fool you completely.

Every Placement Matters

Efficiency is everything. Plan your route through the aisles, decide which tapes to grab first, and keep sequels together — Part 1, 2 and 3 of a series are scattered all over the store, waiting to be reunited on the same shelf. Complete a full shelf to lock in your progress and push the store one step closer to perfect order. Hasty guesses waste time; smart sorting wins the day.

Play Solo Or Team Up

Enjoy the calm, cozy satisfaction of sorting alone, or invite your friends into 2-4 player co-op and turn tidying into beautiful chaos. Split the aisles, call out genres, pass tapes down the line — teamwork gets the store spotless faster... in theory.

Grow Your Skills

Completing shelves and earning XP unlocks abilities that make you a sharper, faster clerk. Carry more tapes at once, spot genres quicker, move faster between aisles, and build your own strategy for turning a mountain of cassettes into perfect order.

Build a dynasty across seven ages

Start with simple tools and a small settlement. Secure resources, establish an economy, and work

through an extensive technology tree that takes your civilization into the modern era.

Create your own civilization

Combine unit lines, building options, technologies, and modules to shape a civilization around your

strategy. Specialize in a powerful economy, fortified positions, mobile armies, or naval and aerial

dominance.

Fight on land, at sea, and in the air

Command infantry, cavalry, siege weapons, ships, submarines, and aircraft. Terrain, elevation, and

army composition influence the course of every battle.

Reshape a destructible voxel world

Buildings and terrain are part of the battlefield. Fire, smoke, craters, and terrain deformation

make the consequences of major battles visible.

Play alone or with others

Face AI opponents or play classic matches with up to eight players. Deterministic lockstep keeps the

same simulation running for every participant and continuously verifies the game state.

Take direct control in Hero Mode

Switch from the strategic view to direct control of an eligible unit while the rest of the battle

continues around you.

VoxelDynasties is developed by a solo developer using a custom Java engine.

store_data.about_the_game:
Everybody Loves a Good Hole is a short, satisfying incremental about steering a black hole and swallowing everything in sight. Devour colorful cubes for XP and coins, grow bigger, and pour it all into a deep upgrade tree. Bigger cubes, wilder chaos, just one more run.

Steer a black hole with your mouse. Pull in hundreds of colorful cubes. Grow. Repeat — but bigger every time.

Swallow everything

Guide your black hole across a bright, chaotic world packed with colorful cubes. Small ones vanish instantly; bigger ones take patience, upgrades, or the right power. The bigger you grow, the more you devour.

Turn cubes into power

Every cube pays out twice: XP to grow your hole mid-run, and coins to keep and spend between runs. Runs are timed, so every second counts.

Dig into a deep upgrade tree

Spend your coins on permanent upgrades — longer runs, wider pull, richer cubes, bigger starting size — and unlock entirely new cube types worth far more than the last.

Unleash magic-book powers

Absorb magic books mid-run to trigger temporary skills like Rain Mode, Duplicate and Magnet. Level them up in the tree, chain them together, and watch the screen erupt into buttery-smooth chaos.

Just one more run

Short, snappy runs and that itch to go again. Chase milestones, unlock the next power, beat your last haul.

Features

  • 🕳️ Steer & swallow — mouse-driven black hole gameplay, easy to learn in seconds

  • 📈 Deep upgrade tree — permanent upgrades across multiple branches

  • 📚 Magic-book skills — unleash and level up powers like Rain Mode, Duplicate and Magnet

  • 🎨 Colorful, chaotic world — hundreds of cubes on screen at once

  • 🧊 Escalating cube types — unlock bigger cubes worth more XP and coins

  • ⏱️ Short & satisfying — quick runs, pure dopamine, no filler

store_data.about_the_game:
You are the commanding officer of an Allied heavy bomber group in the skies over occupied Europe. The Wing hands you a field order and a finite number of men and machines. Which targets you strike, which crews you send, when you push and when you stand down is up to you.

Group Commander is a player-paced command simulation. There are no timers and no background clock ticking against you. Every phase of every mission traces back to a decision you made: at the briefing table, over the target, and in the debrief when the returns come in ragged.

Plan the raid

Each week the Wing deals a fresh board of targets: ball-bearing works, U-boat pens, marshalling yards, aircraft plants. Read the dossier, weigh flak and fighter cover against the reward, and commit your formation.

Fly it, one decision at a time

Watch the raid unfold as a mission profile above the ops log. Fighters come in waves. Flak walks across the formation. An engine throws a rod; the oxygen fails at altitude; the navigator goes down and the course drifts. Press on, divert to the secondary, or bring them home the call is yours.

Carry the cost

Losses are not a number. A downed fort takes named men with it killed, or bailed out and posted missing. Shipmates grieve, green replacements need bedding in, and every fallen man files a letter home that lands on your desk for your signature. Crews fatigue, lose form, break down and, if they live long enough, rotate home at the end of their tour. Shorten the tour to lift morale and the Wing frowns on you. That is the Doolittle dilemma, and it is yours to manage.

Run the station

A bomber base is a town. Feed it the whole station eats, and ration quality moves morale. Stock the bomb dump with the right ordnance for the target: incendiaries for industry, armor-piercing for the pens. Assign mechanics, repair four-axis battle damage, requisition fuel and fresh airframes. Plan your weekly fighter escort as range creeps eastward first the P-47, then the P-38, then the P-51 all the way to the target. Build and upgrade facilities. And keep the Wing's confidence: hit zero, and you are relieved of command.

Everything runs on Command Points

Recruits, facilities, supplies, second chances — everything costs Command Points, earned from missions and never quite sufficient. Command is the art of spending what you cannot spare.

KEY FEATURES

- Player-paced command — no timers; every action is a decision you make

- A living war— a target economy that bleeds when you strike and recovers when you don't

- Real history, on the calendar— max-effort raids pinned to their actual dates

- Named crews— morale, fatigue, form, skills, promotions, and tours of duty

- Losses that land— grief, replacements, and condolence letters you must sign

- Deep station management— mess hall, ordnance, maintenance, facilities, recruiting

- The escort problem— range-limited fighter cover that evolves with the air war

- Wing confidence— perform, or lose your command

store_data.about_the_game:
The print shop runs all night.

You're the one holding the shift together. OVERPRINT is a roguelike bullet heaven about surviving the night shift at a possessed letterpress print shop. You pick your tool, clock in at 10 PM, and mow down waves of printer's devils until the morning edition goes out at 6 AM. You'll level up, evolve your arsenal, get PRINTED or get PULPED. The runs are short, nights are long, and the press is always hungry.

ON THE SHOP FLOOR

  • 9 playable tools of the trade, from the humble Pencil to the Stapler, each with its own way of working the floor.

  • 7 stages, each with an ENDLESS mode, remixable with two OVER PRINT tiers that crank the pressure for better rewards.

  • Test yourself with custom runs. Set the terms, stack the modifiers, and change the rules of the night.

  • 8 weapons, each with an evolution to draft, stack, and combine before dawn.

  • 13 kinds of printer's devils between you and the morning, plus the thing that lives in the press.

  • An OVERTIME rule that banks the win at dawn, then keeps the shift running until the night takes you.

  • The FRONT OFFICE, the shop store. Save your ink between runs and spend it on 20 permanent upgrades.

  • 70 challenges and achievements, and a wardrobe of 16 hats and 13 skins, because morale matters.

Idle Times is a thoughtful desktop companion where Bob quietly files a growing shelf of original illustrated cartoons.

KEEP BOB COMPANY

Set Bob beside your day in a Full Desk, always-on-top Mini Companion, or movable Pet Desk. Help Bob whenever you want a small interaction, or let Autopress keep his work moving while a desk is visible. Bob pauses when hidden, so each cartoon is earned while you keep him company.

A NEW EDITION EACH WEEK

New free editions are added weekly. Your current queue and filed shelf remain yours as Bob's collection grows.

store_data.about_the_game:
The ranch has one rule: nothing goes according to plan.

This is coop multiplayer for 2 to 4 players, and every match the game decides who's who — one of you holds the ranch together, the rest exist purely to take it apart. You've got work piling up and a ranch that needs you. Should be easy enough. Except there's a pack of wolves out there, and their only goal in life is making sure you never get a single thing done.

Playing a wolf means you don't have a job — you ARE the problem. Whatever the Rancher's trying to bring, fix, or finish, that's exactly what you're there to wreck. Dig holes where they'll hurt most. Hide where he'd least expect it. Set traps, break stuff, cause absolute mayhem. There's no clean way to do it, and that's the point.

Don't get too comfortable out there, though. The Rancher's got tools of his own and he is NOT in the mood. Get sloppy, get close, and you might just get launched clean off the map.

Every match throws something new at you, and you never know which side of it you'll be on. Nobody's job looks the same twice. Someone's always panicking, someone's always laughing, and somebody's always getting flung across a field.

Features:

Play together with 1 to 3 friends, any group size welcome

Roles assigned by the game each match, so nobody settles into a routine

A rancher with real objectives and real tools to defend them

A pack of wolves built to stop those objectives cold

Tasks that shift constantly, keeping every round unpredictable

A scoring system where every move counts, for both sides

store_data.about_the_game:
BUILD A TRANSPORT COMPANY, ONE DECISION AT A TIME

Start with a single van and grow into a freight network that spans the whole map. Every contract you take, every truck you buy, and every region you open is a decision — and a real-time clock that pauses whenever you need to think keeps each one a judgment call, not a spreadsheet.

READ THE MARKET, COMMIT YOUR FLEET

Every 6 hours a fresh market of spot contracts opens — but you never see the full picture. Distance and risk arrive as bands, not numbers, so every pickup is a call made on incomplete information.

Your fleet is finite. Weigh each job on three axes at once — money, capacity, and compliance — commit your trucks, and live with the outcome as the clock runs on.

A FLEET OF ROLES, NOT POWER LEVELS

A truck isn't a power level — it's a role. Six vehicle classes and eleven cargo types each bring their own rules: reefers fight spoilage windows, hazardous loads amplify every incident, oversized freight is barred from the fast roads.

The biggest fleet is usually the wrong fleet. You win by assembling the right coverage for the work the market is offering — not by climbing a ladder of ever-bigger trucks.

LICENSES ARE YOUR TECHNOLOGY TREE

Licenses are your technology tree — earned, not bought. Every permit unlocks by growing the company across all three axes: the right equipment, the right scale, and a reputation you've actually built.

Each license opens a new class of cargo and contract, reshaping how you read the market. But run sloppy, and a license can be suspended — right when you need it most.

BUILD A NETWORK ACROSS A GROWING WORLD

Past a certain scale, logistics stops being about single deliveries and becomes about flow. Route freight through hubs that consolidate local runs onto trunk corridors — but every hub has finite throughput, and overloading one backs up everything behind it.

And the world doesn't stand still: new regions open as you grow, each with its own cargo mix and road texture. Climb five company tiers — from local courier to an operator that reaches every region — and every expansion is a new reason yesterday's setup stops working.

AUTOMATE THE ROUTINE, MASTER THE EXCEPTIONS

At scale, standing-order rules take repetitive dispatch off your hands: they accept the routine jobs and assign the right truck without you.

But automation always plays it safe and charges a commission, so a hands-on dispatcher still beats autopilot on any lane they choose to watch. Exceptions surface in the log and wait for your call.

At a glance

  • Real-time management — pause whenever you need to plan

  • Grow from a single van into a freight network across the whole map

  • A fleet of roles, not power levels

  • Cargo with unique constraints — spoilage, hazmat, oversized & high-value freight

  • Licenses as a technology tree

  • Build hub networks — avoid bottlenecks

  • Expand into new regions

  • Five company tiers

  • Optional dispatch automation — convenient, never optimal

  • Reputation that unlocks better contracts

  • Maintenance over randomness

  • Single-player · Sandbox

store_data.about_the_game:
Inside this nightmare, every step you take brings you closer to the unknown. Unlike traditional horror games, the shadows you hide in and the cavernous paths you flee to never remain the same. To survive this eerie world, you must carefully observe your surroundings and navigate the darkness by following the frequencies of the radio in your hands. But beware; the voices echoing from the depths may not always want to guide you. This place will challenge not just your courage, but your every decision.

When your mind begins to play tricks on you, will you be able to separate reality from illusion?

Features:

  • Shifting Labyrinths: A procedurally generated cave structure ensures a completely different, unpredictable exploration and horror experience with every playthrough.

  • Radio Frequency Navigation: A unique audio-driven mechanic where you must trace static noises and mysterious signals to find your way through the dark.

  • Atmospheric Tension: An immersive first-person (FPS) perspective blending distinct pixel-art aesthetics with a modern, dark atmosphere.

store_data.about_the_game:
The only thing you can do in the room you're in is press the red button in front of you. There are a total of 18 tests, each made up of six different mini-games. To escape, you must complete all 18 tests by answering every challenge correctly. A single mistake wipes out all your progress and sends you straight back to the very first room.

Tests:

1. Sounds from the Vents
As soon as the lights go out, your only objective is to survive until they come back on. To do that, you must identify which vent the sound is coming from and press the correct button before it's too late.

2. The Moving Clown
A clown is standing somewhere in the room and changes its position at regular intervals. Before the test begins, you'll be given a set of rules. Your task is to press the button only when the clown is in the correct position according to those rules.

3. Picture Comparison
Images will appear on the screen in front of you. Based on the given rules, you must identify the correct image and press the button that represents it.

4. Colors
A sequence of colors will appear on the screen one by one. You must remember both the colors and the exact order in which they appear. Afterward, you'll answer questions based on that sequence.

5. The Real Clown
Three different clowns will appear in front of you. Your job is to determine which one is the real clown.

6. The Correct Door
Three different doors stand before you, each guarded by a different clown. Only one of those doors leads to the room you're currently trapped in. Your task is to identify the clowns guarding the doors to the other rooms and determine which door is the correct one.

store_data.about_the_game:
GET READY!

A gigantic tear in the sky keeps vomiting trash and scrap metal all over the world! In Scrap Ascent, you step into the circuits of Junkman, a friendly and tenacious superhero determined to reach the top no matter what it takes.

Get ready for fast-paced, frantic, and adrenaline-fueled runs where the only rule is to keep climbing. The environment shifts and attacks you on the fly with short, intense events that will push your reflexes to the limit.

Main Features

  • Breakneck Arcade Action: Quick, straight-to-the-point matches, perfect for retrying over and over until you master the climb.

  • Colorful and Charismatic Pixel Art: A vibrant, detailed visual design full of personality, featuring fluid animations and a charming retro touch.

  • Dynamic Surprise Events: Stay on your toes. The game will surprise you with brief moments of pure chaos: from rogue robots firing crossed lasers to meteors heading straight for you. React fast or start over!

  • Challenging yet Addictive: Easy to grasp in seconds, but with a level of difficulty that will test your precision and agility with every jump.

store_data.about_the_game:
RUN THE LAPS. RUIN THE FRIENDSHIPS.

RAGEBAIT MARATHON is a top-down racing brawler for 1 to 8 players, built in the spirit of the legendary custom map lobbies of classic RTS games. Race clockwise around the track, bank laps at the finish gate, and be the first to hit the lap goal. Simple. Except everyone else is armed.

EVERY LANE, A NEW UNIT

Each corner of the track is a teleport pad that warps you to the next lane and swaps you into a random unit. One lap you are a Sprinter with the fastest legs on the track. The next you are a Landship, a rolling fortress with auto cannons and a cross map torpedo. Then a Gambler whose banked laps are a dice roll. Then a Jinx who banks nothing and wipes the leader's score instead.

36 units, each with its own stats, its own QWER abilities, and its own way of ruining someone's day. Hover any ability in game for a full explanation.

FIGHT DIRTY

Turrets, barricades, traps and beacons let you fortify a corner and make the racing line a war crime
Upgrade cards drop as you score: pick up to 3 and shape your run
One nuke per player per game. A 3 second countdown, then the whole map is wiped. Timing is everything
Hooks, gravity wells, flame cones, homing barrages, cross map snipes, score theft and worse

PLAY IT YOUR WAY

Free for all or Team mode, A versus B with a lobby team picker
Online via Steam, or pure LAN play with no Steam required
Bots that race, brawl, hold their fire during the grace period, and will absolutely nuke you on your final lap
Host controls: lap goal, time limit, and unit bans

HIGH BLOOD PRESSURE INCLUDED

Matches are short, chaotic, and personal. The scoreboard is a lie until the last lap. Bring friends you are willing to lose.

MESSAGE FROM THE DEVELOPER

This is my first ever game. Made by a team of 1 person and some friends that I bought food for to playtest the game. Always open to feedback about the game. Anything about bugs, UI UX, gameplay, new unit ideas, let me know! I will try to implement them ASAP.

store_data.about_the_game:
AYW Pro Manager

Short Description

Run the wrestling company, not just the card. Book shows, manage talent, survive the boardroom, react to a living inbox, and turn weekly chaos into a wrestling empire.

About This Game

AYW Pro Manager is a professional wrestling management game about the pressure, politics, and momentum behind the curtain.

You are not only choosing who wins. You are running the company around every decision.

A weekly show is coming up. The card needs matches. The crowd expects stars. The board wants growth. Talent want opportunities, money, protection, title shots, time off, or answers. Rivals are circling. Your inbox is filling up. And when the show goes live, every segment can change the feeling in the room.

This is a game about building something that lasts.

Book the television. Shape the pay-per-views. Create stories that lift wrestlers from prospects to main-eventers. Manage contracts before rivals turn interest into offers. Keep the locker room from boiling over. Watch your finances. Hit board targets. Develop academy talent. Make promises carefully, because the game remembers.

Book Like A Promoter

Build cards from matches, promos, angles, adverts, title bouts, and specialist stipulations. Balance star power, fatigue, morale, injuries, runtime, championships, rivalries, and crowd patience.

A strong card can lift the company. A careless one can expose weak stories, overwork key names, anger talent, or leave the crowd cold.

Run The Show Live

Event day is not just a results screen.

Step into live production with the running order beside you, crowd response updating through the night, commentary and fan reaction feeding back into the show, and late decisions available before the next segment airs.

Shorten a match. Add a crowd reset. Give the main event more time. Pull a segment if the show is slipping. The card you booked is the plan. Event night is where the plan gets tested.

Manage The People Behind The Product

Your roster is more than a list of ratings.

Wrestlers have contracts, morale, fatigue, health, popularity, relationships, momentum, and expectations. Some want pushes. Some want protection. Some want money. Some just want to know they matter.

You will handle renewals, transfers, promises, injuries, suspensions, medical rest, creative direction, and backstage issues. The best managers do not just book stars. They build trust with them, or at least keep the situation from exploding.

Build A Company, Not Just A Show

The board is watching.

You will manage ticket sales, production costs, sponsorships, TV deals, loans, merchandise, wages, and long-term financial health. The Boardroom tracks trust, warnings, formal requests, and six-month targets.

Book a great show. Sell out a major event. Improve market share. Keep the finances under control. The board will notice success, but it will also notice drift.

A Living Inbox

The inbox is where the wrestling world pushes back.

Show reports, talent demands, board replies, backstage problems, industry news, rival rumours, medical updates, contract issues, and decision-based stories arrive over time. Some are flavour. Some are warnings. Some force you to choose a response.

Your decisions can affect morale, fan trust, owner confidence, cash, fatigue, relationships, promises, and future stories.

Develop The Future

Use the academy to bring through new prospects and shape the next generation of your roster. Build careers from the ground up, form teams and factions, create rivalries, crown champions, and decide who becomes the face of the company.

Success is not only one hot main event. It is turning today’s unknown name into tomorrow’s franchise star.

Fight For Your Place In The Industry

Rival companies do not wait politely.

Track market share, competitor activity, contract interest, rumours, signings, releases, and momentum shifts around the wider wrestling world. Your company’s position can rise or fall depending on the shows you run, the stars you build, and the business decisions you make.

Finances Matter

In AYW Pro Manager, you are in charge of the company's finances. Get a TV deal that covers different parts of the world, accept sponsorship deals (that have obligations you need to meet) and take a look at those merchandise figures (you can give wrestlers a cut of these if you are feeling generous).

Shape Your Own Wrestling World

AYW Pro Manager includes a built-in editor for customizing wrestlers, companies, championships, shows, venues, teams, relationships, and game-world imagery.

Create your own universe, adjust the default one, or build the kind of promotion you always wanted to run.

Key Features

  • Book weekly television and premium live events

  • Run event day with live crowd reactions, commentary, and production changes

  • Manage wrestler morale, injuries, fatigue, contracts, promises, and momentum

  • Create storylines, teams, factions, rivalries, and championship histories

  • Handle finances, sponsorships, TV deals, loans, merchandise, wages, and tickets

  • Respond to inbox decisions that affect the company over time

  • Work with board trust, warnings, requests, and long-term targets

  • Develop academy prospects into future roster members

  • Compete with rival promotions for market share

  • Unlock 100 Hall of Fame badges across Bronze, Silver, Gold, Platinum, and Legend tiers

  • Customize the game world with the built-in editor

AYW Pro Manager is launching as a full initial release

The game already includes the core career experience: weekly and premium event booking, live event-day management, roster and contract systems, finances, sponsorships, boardroom pressure, academy development, news and inbox decisions, rival promotions, Hall of Fame progression, local saves, and a built-in editor.

I plan to continue improving and expanding the game after launch with updates, balance changes, quality-of-life improvements, and additional content based on player feedback.

Dev Diaries

All Your Wrestling has a few dev diaries with more information if you would like to know more;

AI Content Disclosure

Pre-generated AI was used during development to create fictional wrestler portrait artwork. These images are included as static game assets and were reviewed before inclusion. The game does not generate AI content during play.

Shorten a match. Add a crowd reset. Give the main event more time. Pull a segment if the show is slipping. The card you booked is the plan. Event night is where the plan gets tested.

Manage The People Behind The Product

Your roster is more than a list of ratings.

Wrestlers have contracts, morale, fatigue, health, popularity, relationships, momentum, and expectations. Some want pushes. Some want protection. Some want money. Some just want to know they matter.

You will handle renewals, transfers, promises, injuries, suspensions, medical rest, creative direction, and backstage issues. The best managers do not just book stars. They build trust with them, or at least keep the situation from exploding.

Build A Company, Not Just A Show

The board is watching.

You will manage ticket sales, production costs, sponsorships, TV deals, loans, merchandise, wages, and long-term financial health. The Boardroom tracks trust, warnings, formal requests, and six-month targets.

Book a great show. Sell out a major event. Improve market share. Keep the finances under control. The board will notice success, but it will also notice drift.

A Living Inbox

The inbox is where the wrestling world pushes back.

Show reports, talent demands, board replies, backstage problems, industry news, rival rumours, medical updates, contract issues, and decision-based stories arrive over time. Some are flavour. Some are warnings. Some force you to choose a response.

Your decisions can affect morale, fan trust, owner confidence, cash, fatigue, relationships, promises, and future stories.

Develop The Future

Use the academy to bring through new prospects and shape the next generation of your roster. Build careers from the ground up, form teams and factions, create rivalries, crown champions, and decide who becomes the face of the company.

Success is not only one hot main event. It is turning today’s unknown name into tomorrow’s franchise star.

Fight For Your Place In The Industry

Rival companies do not wait politely.

Track market share, competitor activity, contract interest, rumours, signings, releases, and momentum shifts around the wider wrestling world. Your company’s position can rise or fall depending on the shows you run, the stars you build, and the business decisions you make.

Finances Matter

In AYW Pro Manager, you are in charge of the company's finances. Get a TV deal that covers different parts of the world, accept sponsorship deals (that have obligations you need to meet) and take a look at those merchandise figures (you can give wrestlers a cut of these if you are feeling generous).

Shape Your Own Wrestling World

AYW Pro Manager includes a built-in editor for customizing wrestlers, companies, championships, shows, venues, teams, relationships, and game-world imagery.

Create your own universe, adjust the default one, or build the kind of promotion you always wanted to run.

Key Features

  • Book weekly television and premium live events

  • Run event day with live crowd reactions, commentary, and production changes

  • Manage wrestler morale, injuries, fatigue, contracts, promises, and momentum

  • Create storylines, teams, factions, rivalries, and championship histories

  • Handle finances, sponsorships, TV deals, loans, merchandise, wages, and tickets

  • Respond to inbox decisions that affect the company over time

  • Work with board trust, warnings, requests, and long-term targets

  • Develop academy prospects into future roster members

  • Compete with rival promotions for market share

  • Unlock 100 Hall of Fame badges across Bronze, Silver, Gold, Platinum, and Legend tiers

  • Customize the game world with the built-in editor

AYW Pro Manager is launching as a full initial release

The game already includes the core career experience: weekly and premium event booking, live event-day management, roster and contract systems, finances, sponsorships, boardroom pressure, academy development, news and inbox decisions, rival promotions, Hall of Fame progression, local saves, and a built-in editor.

I plan to continue improving and expanding the game after launch with updates, balance changes, quality-of-life improvements, and additional content based on player feedback.

Dev Diaries

All Your Wrestling has a few dev diaries with more information if you would like to know more;

AI Content Disclosure

Pre-generated AI was used during development to create fictional wrestler portrait artwork. These images are included as static game assets and were reviewed before inclusion. The game does not generate AI content during play.

store_data.about_the_game:
A reel came to me in the mail. I'm inside it — a childhood I don't remember at all.

The Dawn Sanatorium closed decades ago. Yet a strip of old film has led you back through its doors, into corridors that only your flashlight can hold back. Somewhere in the dark is a name you've forgotten — and something that remembers you.

Dawn Sanatorium is a slow-burn, first-person psychological horror about memory, identity, and the things a mind buries to survive. Play a reel and the walls rearrange. Search the dormitory for the bed that was yours. Descend to the morgue for a body that was never there. Every fragment you recover pulls the truth closer — and pushes it further out of reach.

You are not being chased. You are being watched. The Horned One does not run. He simply appears — behind you, at a door, in the flicker of the reel — and if you hold his gaze too long, you unravel. In the pitch-black basement, a blind thing hunts by sound; press yourself into a drawer and pray it doesn't hear you breathe. And in the rooms you light up, a nightmare waits for the beam to find it.

Piece the memories together. Reach the bottom of the sanatorium. Learn what really happened here — and to you.

Best played with headphones, in a dark room.

Features

  • Flashlight-driven darkness — the sanatorium is truly dark; your light is your only shield, and it can betray you.
  • A watcher, not a chaser — the Horned One kills with presence and gaze, not a foot race. Look away. Keep moving.
  • Hide from the blind — a sound-hunting horror stalks the basement; tuck into a morgue drawer and stay silent.
  • A reality that rewrites itself — projectors and reels bend the space around you as your memory returns.
  • Fragmented-memory exploration & light puzzles — restore power, find your bed, open the right drawer.
  • A story with a floor beneath the floor — an ending that recontextualizes everything you thought you understood.
  • Fully localized in 7 languages — English, Türkçe, 简体中文, Русский, Español, Português, Deutsch.

store_data.about_the_game:
About the Game

Voltswarm is a single-player 3D bullet heaven about one small robot facing an ever-growing swarm of industrial machines. Your weapons aim and fire automatically, so survival depends on movement, positioning, threat reading, and the build choices you make under pressure.

Gameplay

Draft a starting weapon, collect XP from destroyed machines, and choose upgrades as the swarm grows denser. Combine up to two auto-firing weapons with stat-changing cores and behavior-changing mods. Collect gold, open tiered chests, visit The Scrapper's temporary shop, and activate optional boss portals when you are ready to raise the stakes.

Features

  • Automatic weapons that keep the focus on movement and positioning
  • 11 industrial-themed weapons with distinct attack patterns and upgrade paths
  • Build-defining cores and mods across five rarity tiers
  • A 3D voxel industrial-toy art style designed to keep large swarms readable
  • Six regular enemy types, elites, and two summonable bosses
  • Chests, XP collection, in-run gold, and The Scrapper's temporary shop
  • A ten-minute survival run with escalating enemy density and optional repeated boss fights
  • Keyboard and gamepad input with remappable controls

store_data.about_the_game:
Environment and Story

“Peritheon Station” was once an important waypoint for the sector, a reliable hub where early colonizers of the area refuelled, researchers transmitted data, and crews rested. A fleet of early-generation, general purpose androids handled the heavy labor and maintenance of the station, keeping things running smoothly.

Its glory days are over. With decommissioning imminent, the company has sent you to Peritheon Station to oversee its final shutdown and ensure a smooth retirement. Led by AD4M, a newer-generation android, the crew continues their work none the wiser. However, it isn’t long before you realize something is deeply wrong. The power starts to cut out, the environmental regulators begin malfunctioning, and the androids start watching you a little too long. Worst of all, in this remote sector, help is too far away.

Gameplay

The androids were built for all purposes, including hard industrial labor. Their strength and durability far surpass human capabilities. You can run or hide from them, but avoid direct confrontation.

Scavenge leftover power sources to charge your utility gauntlet. With enough electricity, you might have just enough power to fend off an attack or temporarily disable an android. This energy also powers your wrist-mounted computer, which is essential for unlocking specific containers and doors.

Determine your Fate

How you choose to approach certain problems will matter. Multiple endings are available to achieve, depending on how you navigate Peritheon Station and deal with its crew.

store_data.about_the_game:
Brass Rebellion is an action-arcade, wave-based FPS designed around the use of traps to defeat as many automatons as possible.

You are the only surviving engineer within the heart of the automaton production line. One thing is certain: you will not survive. How many automatons will you take down with you?

Your environment is your weapon

  • Trigger traps with your weapon, the Riveter, and annihilate automatons with a satisfying crunch!

  • Unlock gates and head deeper into the factory.   

  • 7 unique traps to discover.

Manage your supply of steam

  • Steam is your ammo and regenerates over time.

  • Damage is dire! The more damage you take, the less steam you generate.

  • Replenish your steam using stations within the factory.

Battle the hoard, reap the reward

  • 3 unique automaton types to conquer. 

  • Pick up powerups that drop from destroyed automatons.

  • Achieve high scores by surviving waves and defeating automatons.

  • Challenge friends! High scores are saved and displayed in the main menu.

Currencies & crafting

  • Collect scrap and blueprints from destroying automatons and completing waves.

  • Use the workbench to create useful items and repair your durability.

 

About the developers

Brass Rebellion is the result of 8 months of planning and production by the 3rd year students attending Niagara College for the Game Development program. Every asset seen within was created from scratch by these students, including scripts, models, textures, and ideas.

Cheat Codes

Below is a list of cheat codes you can activate at your own leisure:

P - Clear Activated Cheats
H - Hide Active Cheats - Hold H to View
O - Free Gate Purchases
I - Invincibility
L - Lethal Shots
U - No Steam Usage
K - Free Crafting
J - Oneshot Powerup Pierces ALL Materials, Not Just Enemies
M - Infinite Powerups

store_data.about_the_game:
They call it the "Bermuda Triangle of Transylvania."

You are Alex, a man carrying a grief he can't escape and a guilt he can't name. When your dead lover's voice haunts your dreams and calls your name from the depths of the world's most haunted forest, you don't run away. You walk right in.

But something ancient waits between the trees. A cult is hunting, to please its evil master. And the truth about Isabella's death is more terrifying than any creature in these woods.

Run, hide and survive

You have no weapons. You cannot fight what stalks the Hoia Baciu, only vanish into the dark before it finds you. Slip beneath tables, into barrels, behind bushes, and hold your breath as death passes inches away. When your vision blurs and your pulse hammers in your ears, whatever haunts these woods has already found you and you have only once choice: run for your life.

Face Your Past

The deeper you go, the more the forest bleeds into memory. Isabella's voice echoes between the trees, calling, guiding, accusing, leading you toward the truth of a life left behind and a death you can't explain. Piece together what happened through the fragments twisted in your mind, and find your dead lover...or whatever called you here instead.

Any tool comes in handy

Scavenge the forest for the gear you'll need to survive and progress. A lighter and GPS help you find your way through the dark, while a journal lets you record the runes and symbols you discover along the way. When something gets too close, a flare gun can drive it back or buy you time to run, but ammo is limited, so use it carefully.

These are just a few of the items waiting to be found, each one a small advantage in a place that offers none.

The legends are real

Inspired by the chilling folklore of Romania's Hoia Baciu Forest, this is the first chapter in the Dark Realms series. On the surface, the woods are picturesque, but beneath that calm, darkness and evil spread like a plague, and no one who enters is ever seen walking out. The story unfolds across multiple chapters, each with its own mechanics, enemies,  collectables and secrets to uncover.

The things that share these woods are older than the cult that worships them. Drawn from the darkest corners of Romanian myth, each is a horror with its own nature and its own rules for surviving it:

  • The Moroi: the restless undead, risen from unquiet graves to feed on the living.

  • The Solomonar: a weather-wizard of forbidden knowledge, master of the storms and the beasts that answer to him.

  • Muma Pădurii: the Mother of the Forest, an ancient hag who preys on the lost and the wandering.

Decode the Forest

Ancient runes bar your path and mechanisms rust in forgotten huts. Solve environmental puzzles woven into the world while cross-referencing your symbols journal, read the signs the dead left behind, and unlock the routes that lead you deeper.

This game is a work of fiction inspired by real-world folklore. No real locations were harmed in the making. Please respect all real-world private property.

Mature Content: Contains gore, death, and extreme violence that some players may find disturbing.

store_data.about_the_game:
Place down structures that empty out the wallets of your customers!

There are tons of different ways to scam a person - and you are not afraid to use them all at once. Be it rigged slot machines, wheels of fortune that never win or empty trading card packs - your cunning knows no bounds and your customers will happily stroll left to right in your apartment to empty out their pockets.

Started from the bottom, now we're here!

Your shady business starts in your moldy, small apartment. Tough times never last, only tough people last! With time, you'll be able add more rooms, upgrade the interior and, with it, gain a lot more money as customers stream in!

Decorations are not just for looksies!

Each decoration has an effect that dramatically increases your growth as a scammer or just quadruples your cheddar. Be it dozens of eviction notes crammed into one corner or a luxurious chandelier hanging from the ceiling - find a layout that ultimately makes you richer and looks cool at the same time! ... or only just richer, you do you.

Join the organization!

The secret "Scam Society"  may eventually take notice of your exploits and invite you into its ranks. Trade passports, credit cards, and fake IDs for research points to unlock even more elaborate ways of scamming your unsuspecting customers.

Full touch support!

This game utilizes drag and drop for interaction and can be played with only your mouse! On steam deck or mobile, you can even play the game completely using only the touch controls. This game was made with both desktop and mobile consoles and platforms in mind.

Join the organization!

The secret "Scam Society"  may eventually take notice of your exploits and invite you into its ranks. Trade passports, credit cards, and fake IDs for research points to unlock even more elaborate ways of scamming your unsuspecting customers.

Full touch support!

This game utilizes drag and drop for interaction and can be played with only your mouse! On steam deck or mobile, you can even play the game completely using only the touch controls. This game was made with both desktop and mobile consoles and platforms in mind.

Place down slot machines that never pay out, sell trading card packs that never have any hits and slowly build up your riches to upgrade your apartment until it looks like the most professional scam operation ever!

store_data.about_the_game:
Build traps and race your friends.

BUILD & BAIL is a 3D party platformer for 2-6 players. Before every race, everyone secretly places a trap or platform on the track, then you all race at the same time. Round after round there are more traps in the way and the race gets more chaotic.

How a round works

First, each player selects a piece from a random list of all available pieces.


Then, each player places their piece anywhere on the map.

Once everything is in place, the new pieces are revealed and the race begins.

Features

  • Your track, your chaos New traps arrive every round. By the end, the track is a minefield made of your own ideas.

  • A nasty arsenal Saw blades, pendulums, cannons, wind cannons, jump traps, honey fields, ice patches and more.

  • Snappy movement Double jump, wall jump, dash. Easy to learn, but fast players stay in front.

  • Tracks that go up Candy towers, neon rooftops, glaciers, lava fields, desert ruins. Always with multiple routes and shortcuts.

  • Your rules Score target, rounds, respawns, player collision, sudden death: the host decides how mean it gets.

  • Character workshop Colour, hat, face. Look your best before you fall into the lava.

  • Easy to play together Steam lobbies: invite friends, share a code or open a public lobby.

Short rounds, big schadenfreude. Perfect for a night with friends who might not stay friends.

store_data.about_the_game:
The sun has set, the school halls are pitch black, and everyone is already gone. You only have one simple task: grab the groceries and run straight home. But in the quiet shadows of this suburban neighborhood, you are far from alone.

Don't Talk To Strangers is a stylized, psychological lo-fi horror game that captures the terrifying vulnerability of being small in a world full of hidden threats. Featuring an atmospheric fixed cinematic camera style and a dynamic sanity system, every choice and every conversation could be your last.

Can you make it home safe, or will you listen to the voices in the dark?

Key Features:

  • Mind Your Sanity: The shadows are empty... until your mind begins to slip. The relentless stalker Monster only hunts you when your sanity runs low. Cling to fleeting moments of comfort like playing on park swings, choosing kind responses to NPCs, or simply standing in the warm, buzzing glow of a vending machine because you're too broke to buy anything. But remember: nowhere is truly safe.

  • The "Weeping" Strangers: Interact with over 40+ unique NPCs. But beware: some are stalkers in disguise.talk to wrong one, and they will silently pursue you the moment you turn your back.

  • Lethal Neighborhood Hazards: The streets are just as dangerous as the monsters. Avoid instant-death "Dread" entities by keeping your distance, dodge oncoming cars, and watch your step around treacherous potholes in the dark.

  • The Ashamed Ghost of the School: Before you even reach the streets, you must escape the school. Avoid the gaze of a dangerous little girl ghost who is too ashamed to show her face and survive a heart-pounding classroom chase sequence.

  • Deep Replayability: Discover 6 distinct endings shaped entirely by the paths you take, the hazards you avoid, and how well you manage your terror.

  • Retro Lo-Fi Aesthetic: A gorgeous, low-poly art style wrapped in a moody, CRT/VHS scanline presentation that feels like a lost retro classic.

Start with a modest lot and grow it into a thriving supply empire. In Supply Yard Simulator, you're in charge of every part of the operation — sourcing and stocking landscaping and construction materials, organizing your yard for maximum efficiency, and keeping the wheels turning as orders roll in.

Hop between a full roster of heavy equipment to get the job done right. Load pallets with the forklift, swing heavy beams and pipe with the crane, haul bulk material with the loader, and gravel and soil. Need to move loads across the yard or across town? Jump on the flatbed truck. Got a waterside delivery? Take the boat out and get it there.

Every delivery matters. Plan your routes, load your vehicles carefully, and get materials to job sites on time to build your reputation and unlock more equipment and a larger yard. Manage your inventory, balance your budget, and expand your operation from a single small lot into a sprawling, fully-equipped supply yard.

  • Plan and complete deliveries across land and water

store_data.about_the_game:
Dice × Monster Raising × Party Building!

Triple Dice Monsters is a turn-based RPG where you raise monsters, build your own party, and battle using dice. Raise monsters through a board game-style adventure, then let the dice decide the outcome of every battle in a unique blend of luck and strategy.

Raise Monsters

In Raising Mode, choose a monster and set off on a board game-style adventure!

Roll three dice and choose the result you want to move across the board. Battles and events await on every space. Win battles to choose one of three rewards and strengthen your monster's stats or abilities. Keep growing your monster until you're defeated or reach the end of the board to create a truly unique companion!

Challenge Bosses

In Boss Challenge Mode, build a party using the monsters you've raised and take on a variety of unique bosses!

Go all-in with an offensive team, counter each boss with specialized strategies, or create your own tactics and party composition to claim victory!

Dice-Based Battles

Every monster has six unique action skills, each assigned to one of the six dice faces.

Each turn, roll three dice and simply choose one result. Your monsters will automatically use the action skill tied to that number. The controls are simple, but choosing the right party and making the most of your dice rolls is the key to victory.

Inheritance System

The Inheritance System is the heart of Triple Dice Monsters' deep progression.

In Raising Mode, you can assign up to two previously raised monsters as Inheritance Monsters. During special inheritance events on the board, their abilities can be passed on to the monster you're currently raising. Chain inheritances together to create even stronger monsters. Mastering the Inheritance System and choosing the right combinations is the key to creating the ultimate monster!

store_data.about_the_game:
It only moves when you look away. The job is looking away.

You're sealed in a dying server vault with one flashlight and a purge quota. The warden running this place demands corrupted sectors be purged before the clock expires. The terminals are in the dark. So is something else. Your light freezes it; your work needs that same light. Ration one beam between two deadlines, and listen to the part of the dark you're not watching.

The loop

  • Pin it - your cone holds it where it stands. The beam drains. The purge stalls.

  • Work it - aim at a terminal and the view drops to the monitor: heads-down, blind, the room gone.

  • Watch the glass - the dark screen holds a reflection. It's the only warning you get, and the one you'll learn to hate.

  • The whip-back - the sound spikes; snap the light back. It's right there, frozen an arm's length away.

  • No AI-generated content - every light is computed, every sound is procedural, every cruelty is designed.

The warden is a director, not a dice roll

A warden studies how you work, waits until you're deepest in the task, then times its cruelty.

  • The Cold One starves you of sound.

  • The Liar corrupts your readouts. The threat never lies; the paperwork does.

  • The Reaper just tightens the clock.

Every cruelty telegraphs. Every death is an out-play, never a cheat. Learn its tells or be reaped as ordered.

Migraine-safe horror

Dread without the strobe. No strobes, no flashing, no screamer roulette. The fear is engineered from attention, audio, and silence: what you can't afford to watch, and what you can hear getting closer. Every frame is flash-safety-checked.

No AI-generated content. Every light is computed, every sound is procedural, every cruelty is designed.

The full game is a career ladder of shifts that escalate in rules, not just speed: deeper sectors, new wardens with new tells to learn, and an endgame that rewrites the contract. First shift free. A short, dense game priced like one.
