store_data.about_the_game:
WELCOME TO THE ULTIMATE CO-OP ADVENTURE

Grab a friend and punch your way through a colorful adventure where every level is a giant theme park packed with outrageous attractions, hidden secrets, and over-the-top boss battles.

Your prehistoric best friend TUU has vanished after a trip to the world's most spectacular theme parks. What begins as a rescue mission quickly spirals into something much bigger. Behind the roller coasters, water slides, ancient temples, and prehistoric attractions lies a sinister conspiracy orchestrated by the powerful DUX Corporation.

Fight through unforgettable worlds, rescue your friends, uncover the truth, and stop DUX before its experiments reshape the future forever.

EXPLORE INCREDIBLE THEME PARKS

Forget dark streets and abandoned warehouses.

Battle your way through vibrant, handcrafted theme parks inspired by giant Mayan temples, tropical waterparks, futuristic laboratories, ancient megafauna, and more. Every world is filled with interactive attractions, environmental hazards, hidden collectibles, and spectacular boss encounters that constantly surprise you.

FAST, SATISFYING BEAT 'EM UP COMBAT

Easy to pick up. Deep to master.

Chain together flashy combos, devastating grabs, launch attacks, aerial juggles, and powerful Special Moves as you send enemies flying across the screen.

Smash them into scenery, trigger environmental traps, discover combat puzzles, and use each arena to your advantage.

EIGHT HEROES. EIGHT PLAYSTYLES.

Choose from a cast of unforgettable fighters, each with their own personality, abilities, and fighting style.

Whether you're crushing enemies with Nikki's overwhelming strength, unleashing Ivy's unpredictable inventions, singing opponents into submission with Angelo's operatic attacks, or discovering the rest of the crew, every character offers a fresh way to play.

POWER UPS CHANGE EVERYTHING

Collect ridiculous power-ups throughout your adventure that completely transform how you fight.

Experiment with new abilities, discover powerful combinations, and adapt your strategy as every level throws new surprises your way.

BUILT FOR CO-OP

Everything is better with friends.

Play solo or team up locally with up to four players to battle through the entire campaign together. Revive teammates, combine attacks, discover secrets, and create the kind of chaotic moments only great couch co-op can deliver.

BIG BOSSES. BIGGER PERSONALITIES.

Every world ends with an unforgettable showdown against larger-than-life villains from the DUX Corporation.

Each boss introduces unique mechanics, attack patterns, and cinematic moments that keep every encounter fresh and memorable.

A WORLD WORTH SAVING

Beneath the bright attractions and playful charm hides a mystery waiting to be uncovered.

As your search for TUU unfolds, you'll discover that the parks are only the surface of an operation far more dangerous than anyone imagined. Piece together the truth behind DUX Corporation, confront its eccentric villains, and fight to save your friend before it's too late.

FEATURES

  • 1–4 Player Local Co-Op Story Mode

  • 1–4 Player Local Co-Op Arena Mode

  • 8 Unique Playable Heroes

  • Four Massive Theme Park Worlds

  • Action-Packed Beat 'Em Up Combat

  • Platforming and Exploration

  • Environmental Combat Puzzles

  • Unlockable Costumes and Collectibles

  • Epic Boss Battles

  • Hidden Secrets Throughout Every Level

POWER UPS CHANGE EVERYTHING

Collect ridiculous power-ups throughout your adventure that completely transform how you fight.

Experiment with new abilities, discover powerful combinations, and adapt your strategy as every level throws new surprises your way.

Everything is better with friends.

Play solo or team up locally with up to four players to battle through the entire campaign together. Revive teammates, combine attacks, discover secrets, and create the kind of chaotic moments only great couch co-op can deliver.

Every world ends with an unforgettable showdown against larger-than-life villains from the DUX Corporation.

Each boss introduces unique mechanics, attack patterns, and cinematic moments that keep every encounter fresh and memorable.

store_data.about_the_game:
Two Visual Novels in one!

This is a packaging of the first and second visual novels in the A Fortnight at Frenni Fazclaire's line. Each involves you working a night club in which the main performers and draw are animatronic women that parody characters from the famous Five Nights at Freddy's line of games. But not all is as it seems on the surface. Should you take risks and delve into the mysteries, you'll find yourself racing to save souls, including your own!

Upgraded F@FF 1!

As part of making this duology, the first A Fortnight at Frenni Fazclaire's visual novel has been upgraded from the (relatively) old code base to the much more modern one used by the second visual novel. This means more responsiveness AND additional, animated scenes exclusive to this duology!

More Quality of Life changes!

While F@FF 2 is/was on a better code base, there were still some quality of life changes that we were able to implement to make your experience more enjoyable in both games! We're talking proper controller support, saved games labeled by specific night/day, enhanced menus, proper crosstalk between the two visual novels, and more!

What new players can expect from F@FF 1:

Choose between a male and a female perspective as you dive into the mystery surrounding Frenni Fazclaire's quirky animatronics as the new night guard. You've got 14 days and 6 distinct endings along with 27 hand-illustrated H-Scenes to discover. Every choice matters!

Animatronics include Bonfie, Chiku, Fexa, Frenni and three more who you'll meet during play depending on your choices!

What new players can expect from F@FF 2:

You play as the male Chief Engineer of a brand new sister club to the one in the original visual novel. You'll dive into the mystery surrounding four of Frenni Fazclaire's quirky, prototype animatronics: Aurora the Tiger, Chi the Bird, Mia Mangle, and Roxy the Wolf. You've again got 14 days, 5 distinct endings, and 15 hand-illustrated H-Scenes to discover. Again, every choice matters!

store_data.about_the_game:
Combine converters, connect the pipes, and deliver nuts to the hamster.


This is a logic puzzle where you place converters on nodes to design the flow of the pipes. Sort the nuts and stones flowing from the source using combinations of converters, and deliver only the nuts to the hamster waiting at the goal. Delivering a stone counts as a miss — two misses and it's game over.

Simple puzzle design

Since all you do is switch converters, even beginners can jump right in.

  • Intuitive converter placement — Select a converter to open a dialog, and switch converters while checking the reference chart
  • An expressive hamster — Enjoy its delighted reactions every turn a nut arrives
  • Tense turn-based challenges — Clear 10 turns per level within a 3-minute time limit. You can also use "Unlock Route" to free a locked node for a single turn
  • Reliable autosave — Your progress is saved automatically with every placement and turn, so you can stop anytime and pick up right where you left off
  • Difficulty for everyone — With a built-in tutorial, beginners can play with confidence. From easy stages to mind-bending challenges, every level brings something new to discover

A simple puzzle that still makes you think. Build the optimal circuit with your own hands and deliver nuts to the hamster!

store_data.about_the_game:
Outono Adventures is a 3D adventure game where a german girl named Vanessa discovers that her best friend, Amanda, whom she hasn't seen in weeks, is trapped inside a video game.

However, instead of breaking the CD to save her friend, Vanessa decides to try playing the game and ends up being dragged inside. She is then transformed into a court jester named Outono, and she will face many adventures, far beyond just jumping on enemies' heads, to find her friend and return to the real world.

Features:

- 8 Levels Doors and 1 Boss Battle Room.

- Volumes Slider from Music & SFX

- Full Screen or Window mode toggle.

- FPS Counter.

- Resolution settings.

- Quality settings (plays on low, medium, high or ultra graphics).

Controls (they can be remapped to your liking in-game settings; this is the first game of mine that allows to do that.):

-WASD move the Player (but in certain phases it's also used to move the Kart and the Car driving);

-Space for Jump and Double Jump (but in certain phases her can brake the kart, brake the car and shoot in zombies).

-E for Interaction (for example, for enter the circus, enter the levels, and many other things...)

-ESC for Pause the Game.

-F12 for Capture a Screenshot (It is saved by default in the My Pictures folder.)

-Z for Kick a Ball (only when she touches a ball, but in the kart phase, she can generate and throw balls at enemies.)

- Mouse controls the camera and Scroll controls the distance of the camera.

Outono the Jester belongs to Vanessa C. Waldeck, the Pika Vani

About This Game

Slayer Queen is a bullet heaven roguelite where rock music, alternative fashion, and the chaos of purgatory collide in intense 3-minute runs. Fight through endless hordes of enemies, create devastating weapon and ability builds, and battle to the sound of a licensed soundtrack featuring emerging independent artists.

Play as Helena St. Clair, a teenage girl who has just arrived in the afterlife. Lost in purgatory and searching for a new identity that will define the rest of her eternity, she'll carve her way through corrupted souls while collecting the things she loves most: alternative fashion, new accessories, and the perfect soundtrack for her new life.

Survive relentless waves of enemies, defeat powerful bosses, collect Souls and Coins to upgrade your arsenal, and experiment with different combinations of weapons and abilities. Every run is a new opportunity to refine your strategy, unlock new content, and prove you have what it takes to become the ultimate Slayer Queen.

Features

  • Fast-paced 3-minute runs packed with action.

  • Wield up to 10 unique weapons, each with its own combat style.

  • Unlock outfits and accessories to customize Helena's look.

  • Discover a licensed soundtrack featuring emerging independent artists as you expand your music collection.

  • Experiment with different combinations of weapons, abilities, and upgrades to create your own playstyle.

  • Replay stages to unlock new content and overcome increasingly difficult challenges.

store_data.about_the_game:
Cyber Volleyball is a 2D volleyball battle game from a side-scrolling perspective, combining precise physics simulation, deep character progression, diverse enemy mechanics, and online multiplayer.

Realistic 2D Volleyball Physics

The game uses a Unity-based 2D parabolic physics engine, fully simulating the effects of gravitational acceleration, object weight, air resistance, and friction on ball movement. Every bounce, deceleration, and collision with the court, net, and players is calculated in real time. The game implements a strict three-hit system following international volleyball rules, with visual UI feedback showing the current hit count. Two trajectory prediction lines—high and low—are drawn on screen to help you anticipate the landing point and make the best play.

Diverse Characters and Enemies

The game features over a dozen character types, each with unique AI behavior and exclusive skills:

  • Main Attacker: Powerful spikes, the finisher in head-to-head battles

  • Setter: Receives and distributes passes, the core of offensive organization

  • Middle Blocker: A versatile player skilled in both blocking and quick attacks

  • Libero: A defensive specialist focused on receiving and digging

  • Hunter: Possesses pursuit abilities, striking the ball with tremendous force

  • Claw: Instantly pulls the ball toward itself for surprise attacks

  • Shockwave: Generates a shockwave on spikes, knocking back opposing players

  • Violence: Spikes carry devastating additional effects

  • Ice: Attacks can briefly freeze opponents, locking down their movements

  • Eater: Swallows the ball and controls its movement

  • Builder: Creates obstacles in front of the net for blocking

  • Shooter: Charges up and precisely fires the ball at targeted positions

Each enemy requires different tactics to overcome, keeping every match fresh and engaging.

Stages and Adventure Mode

The game offers multiple modes to choose from:

  • Tutorial Mode: Learn the game's controls and rules step by step

  • PVE Mode: Challenge AI opponents of varying difficulty levels

  • PVP Mode: Local battles against friends

  • EVE Mode: Watch thrilling AI vs. AI matches

  • Adventure Mode: Conquer multiple stages and face increasingly powerful enemy combinations

The stage system supports paginated browsing with 28 stages per page, each offering up to a three-star rating. As difficulty increases, some stages trigger special mechanics—such as making enemy players invisible—testing your reflexes and judgment. All stage star data is saved locally, so you can review your progress at any time.

Character Card and Progression System

Through the card system, you can deeply customize your team. The game features two types of cards: Character Cards and Item Cards.

Character Cards offer 9 upgradeable attributes: Size, Defense, Jump, Speed, Strength, Reaction, Spike Range, Dig, and Dash. Spend stars earned from stages to upgrade, with each point directly affecting your players' actual in-game performance.

Item Cards provide various match effect bonuses, including:

  • Increasing the maximum team size

  • Removing the opponent's first-touch effect

  • Displaying the ball's landing point prediction

  • Adding a freezing effect to attacks

  • Making the ball lighter as hit count increases

Strategically combine cards to build your ultimate lineup.

Online Multiplayer

Through the built-in lobby system, you can create or join public rooms to battle other players online. When creating a room, you can set a password, maximum player count, and visibility, with automatic matchmaking also available to quickly find opponents.

Inside a room, you can freely choose positions such as Main Attacker, Middle Blocker, Setter, or Libero. The system checks for duplicate positions within the same team to ensure balanced lineups. Once all players are ready, the match begins immediately. The game uses a server-authoritative network architecture to ensure fair synchronization of physics calculations and match results. Real-time chat messages during matches allow you to communicate with opponents and teammates.

Comprehensive Settings and Customization

The game provides a complete settings system, covering volume adjustment (independent control of Master, BGM, and SFX), display effects (glow on/off, customizable ball trail color gradients), key bindings (fully customizable keyboard controls), and mobile touch sensitivity adjustment. All settings are saved automatically and can be restored to defaults at any time. The game also supports one-touch toggling between fullscreen and windowed mode with F11.

Dual-Platform Control Support

Supports both keyboard (arrow keys to move, spacebar to jump, J/K/L for actions) and mobile touch gesture controls. On mobile, swipe direction and length are recognized and mapped to different volleyball actions, letting you enjoy a match anytime, anywhere.

Key Features Summary

  • 2D volleyball battles based on realistic physics simulation

  • Over a dozen enemy types with distinct AI behaviors and skills

  • Five game modes: Tutorial, PVE, PVP, EVE, and Adventure

  • Deep character card progression system with 9 freely upgradeable attributes

  • Item card system providing rich strategic combinations

  • Online multiplayer with room creation, matchmaking, and real-time chat

  • Complete key binding customization and display effect settings

  • Supports both keyboard and mobile touch controls

store_data.about_the_game:
Answer the Call

An SOS draws you toward a remote island and the darkened manor overlooking its shore. Inside, the people who once lived and worked there have been transformed into violent creatures, enormous black feathers driven through their eyes and chests.

Search the estate, find those who remain, and uncover what has taken root within the manor before it spreads beyond the island.

Survive the Estate

Combat is fast, loud, and likely to attract more enemies. Fight with melee weapons, firearms, and explosives, or move carefully and slip past threats before they become overwhelming.

Use doors and chokepoints to control pursuit, prepare traps, and turn explosive barrels against groups of enemies. Search for coins and spend them at vending machines on ammunition, healing supplies, and armor. Resources are available, but survival depends on using them well.

The Manor Changes Behind You

Solve puzzles, collect keys, open locked chests, and uncover hidden passages throughout an interconnected estate. New discoveries lead back into familiar areas, where previously blocked routes, survivor interactions, and unexpected encounters may now be waiting.

A hallway does not remain safe simply because you have already survived it.

No One Is Guaranteed to Survive

Every survivor has a story shaped by earlier conversations and actions. Your choices influence where they appear, what they reveal, and whether their paths continue.

Survivors can be protected, abandoned, or killed by the creatures roaming the estate—and they are not protected from you. Save everyone, save no one, or escape with only a few. The nightmare can still be confronted, but who lives to see its end is not guaranteed.

store_data.about_the_game:
Best Viewed Up Close is an interactive oil painting. Over 1,000 physical canvases, painted by hand, photographed, and brought to life as a meadow you can explore.

You are the guy with the plan. The meadow comes out, the gravel goes down, the concrete goes over it, and by Sunday there is a parking spot where all this used to be. Boots on, gloves on, no shirt, sunburn already going. Then the grass got tall. Or you got small. Either way, the job is on hold, and the meadow has you exactly where it wants you.

There is no combat. There are no fail states. There is a world you were about to erase without ever once looking at it. Time to look.

A meadow made of paint

Wander a Pacific Northwest meadow rendered in thick, textured oil. Climb foxglove stalks. Ride a drifting petal across the pond. Catch a lift from a bee to the sunflower heads. Every region is its own palette, and every surface is a real brushstroke.

Meet what the concrete would cover

The meadow is full of small lives, and every one of them is in the footprint. A beetle rolling its prize down the gravel path. Aphids in a line under a leaf. A spider rebuilding her web after rain. Notice them, get close, and they join your field journal, where every entry is a crop of a real canvas.

And the robin

Sometimes a shadow crosses the grass and everything small goes quiet. Nothing here will hurt you. But down at this size you are the small thing now, and one of the neighbors is the size of a building. Earn the last page of your journal by getting close.

Made by hand, every frame

This is not a filter or a shader. Over 1,000 real oil paintings went into this world, and more are on the easel right now.

  • An interactive oil painting: every sprite and scene hand-painted on canvas

  • Play a shrunken man, dish gloves and all, in the meadow he was about to pave

  • Gentle exploration at miniature scale, no combat, no fail states

  • A field journal of painted entries to fill, and to share

  • One continuous meadow across distinct painted regions

The parking spot can wait. Oil on canvas.

store_data.about_the_game:
Password Not Valid is a chaotic party game for up to 4 players where each aplyer must build their own password in an environment where the rules never stop changing.

Type your password

Every round starts simple: type a password. And while it might be easy at first, before you know it, your password will need to have as many vowels as numbers, alternate uppercase and lowercase, be packed with symbols, include Roman numerals, and face some other crazy requirements... But don't worry: your password doesn't have to be perfect, it just needs to be better than your friends'.

Outsmart your friends

In Password Not Valid, players take turns changing the rules of the game. Because of this, the smartest move is rarely the safest one. Slipping in a clever trick that satisfies three rules at once will make you look like a genius, until the next rule flips the board and turns your brilliant idea into your own downfall. There will also be voting to choose the next twist: the group decides its own chaos (and there's always someone voting for the option that hurts you specifically).

Password Not Valid rewards reading the board, following the rules, and finding the single string of characters that satisfies all of them at once before your friends do... or before they find a way to sabotage you.

Gather up to three friends online and find out who is truly best at bringing order to the chaos.

store_data.about_the_game:
Die. Loot. Live. You decide how deep it goes.

Enemies spawn, you strike, they fall, and loot drops automatically. Your real game is the build: skills, gear, and a web of interlocking systems that carry a lone hero from the surface down into the crushing dark.

Combat runs on its own. What you control is everything around it: which skills you slot, how you weigh a stat, when to push a boss and when to farm, which of a dozen deep systems to chase on any given session. Five acts, three difficulties, each a rewarding progression. Then an endgame that unfolds for weeks.

Death is part of the loop, not a fail state. When a boss is killing you, you're not stuck, you're under-geared. Drop into a Farm Zone or another event, idle a bit for loot and XP, and come back stronger. If it feels impossible, you're meant to farm first.

Four classes, four philosophies

Each class is a different relationship with your gear, and sub-specializations branch every one into distinct builds.

The loot chase

Every drop is a choice, use, bank, destroy for skill mastery. A full rarity ladder Normal, Magic, Rare, three tiers of Uniques, Sets, Artifacts, and Bloodpit-forged Blood Artifacts auto-equipped by a scoring system you can bias toward your build.

  • Set pieces that rewrite the fight. Assembled by grinding, boss after boss. Bonus stats for completion and with signature effects that change how combat plays: blocks refund HP, crits chill, burns spread, kills pay gold, and more.

  • Craft, gamble, ascend. Reforge with various gem families (knowing every reforge risks the piece), enchant, infuse, petition the Divine Altar, and visit a daily Traveling Tinker who can enhance your already powerful item even more.

  • Nothing legendary left behind. Even if you outgrow a favorite unique you can wake it at the Awakening bench, rescaled to your current power and difficulty, its story grows with you.

  • An honest drop ladder. Magic Find bends every rung of the curve without breaking it. A lucky hour feels lucky, and a god-tier drop gives you that same feeling it used to.

Systems all the way down

Not a prestige button and a number its a web of activities, each with its own reason to log in (or queue up and don't).

  • The Delve. a bottomless descent. Fight guardians, push past your deepest-ever, pull mythic Artifacts from the dark.

  • Guided Descent. Take the tunnels by the hand: a branching map of shrine pacts, springs, and encounters that bargain. A revenant clutching gear you died with. A chest that bites.

  • The Bloodpit. A timed slaughter rite. Feed the Red Maw and it forges a boon from your offerings the deeper the rite, the stranger the reward.

  • Bounty Board. Named-target contracts with rewards stated upfront.

  • Damage schools & ailments.  Burn, chill, freeze, shock, bleed, poison, sunder resists, and true damage to ignore it. Stack them, spread them, crit on their ticks.

  • Masteries, Relics, and the Constellation. Twenty-plus account-wide mastery tracks that slowly improve every aspect of gameplay, triggered relic treasures that feed on kills, and a star map of permanent power paid for by achievement unlocks.

  • The Expedition Log. A living codex of uniques, sets, relics, artifacts, and records. Something to complete beneath the completion and a collectors dream.

Two ways to descend

  • Arcade Mode. The classic run, measured in hours to days. Fast-forward up to 3×, levels uncapped past 50, loot flowing then the Desolation, the Delve, and the Bloodpit waiting beneath.

  • Epoch Mode. The slow burn, measured in days to weeks. A harder world at true 1× speed with 12 Ascendancy paths (3 per character) that change the way you play, again. A second relic slot, exclusive items, and offline progress that never stops.

  • The Everdeep. Beyond even that: a looping conquest where the world reseals and begins again, harder each lap, paying out Divine Shards for the god-forging of your finest gear and trying to keep up. The horizon keeps receding. That's the point.

  • Set up a queue and drop it into 'mini' mode while you work:

Lastly it's Idle, done honestly.

Queue your loops and close the game. It doesn't hand-wave your progress: it fully simulates it.

  • The Idle Queue replays your plan. Real kills, real drops, honest results waiting on login.

  • A fair taper. Returns start high and ease off the longer you're away, resetting each visit.

  • Cloud saves. A short-ish sync code walks your characters between desktop, browser, and phone.

Die. Loot. Live.

store_data.about_the_game:
Area Survivors combines top-down survival action with base defense.

Take on the role of a lone knight and defend the central tower against relentless hordes of enemies. Defeat enemies to earn experience and upgrade your weapons and skills whenever you level up. Improve attributes such as attack power, attack range, and attack speed to create a combat style that suits you.

One of the game’s defining mechanics is painting the battlefield. Painted ground slows the enemy advance and triggers various effects tied to the areas you control. Expanding advantageous territory before the enemy closes in—and deciding where to make your stand—is a key part of each battle.

Survival is not your only objective—you must also protect the central tower from the advancing enemies. Watch their movements, adjust your positioning, and use your upgraded weapons and skills to defend your base.

As time passes, the enemies will become more numerous and more powerful, eventually leading to an encounter with a formidable boss. Strengthen yourself before you are surrounded and fight your way through the oncoming waves.

Use tokens earned in battle to permanently unlock and upgrade abilities for the player, buildings, and the central tower through the skill tree. Take on repeated challenges, acquire new abilities, and prepare for your next battle.

Key Features:

  • Top-down survival action against massive hordes of enemies

  • A distinctive battlefield-painting system that slows enemy advances and triggers area-based effects

  • Weapon and skill upgrades to choose from each time you level up

  • Base-defense gameplay that requires protecting both the knight and the central tower

  • Increasingly intense enemy waves as time passes

  • Powerful bosses awaiting you at the end of each stage

  • Permanent upgrades for the player, buildings, and central tower through the skill tree

store_data.about_the_game:
The gargantuan dieselpunk train, the IRON SANCTUARY, is mankind’s last hope after the calamity of 1920. Your mission and penitence is to manage and direct it through the remains of civilization after the Great War.

Choose which city you will rescue next and the route you will take. Use the information given the by higher command, as well as tools and your own wit. Measure distances, use the compass to circle areas, place markers and even utilize occult paraphernalia.

Within the city, raise the giant drill miners and release the cart ways that fuel the IRON SANCTUARY. The fuel should last throughout your journey.



Demolished terrain, hellish fields, inhumane temperatures and various obstacles may be encountered on the route, causing problems on board. Secure the pressure valves, replace the broken pipe parts, ensure every mechanism is up to speed. Resume travel.

Rescue as many people as you can from the calamity. Choose your route wisely, as both distance and breakdown can result in stalling, and each day increases the death count.

After you made sure that the route is set, the tank refueled and the safety measures checked, enter the control pit and IGNITE THE ENGINE.

Safe travels, conductor - - God. Humanity. Salvation!

KEY FEATURES

  • Immersive Train Conducting: Maneuver the outworldly train behemoth, the IRON SANCTUARY, secured from the hell outside.

  • Alternate Apocalyptical Setting: After the end of the Great War, in the 1920s hell overlapped with Earth leading to countless suffering. You have been living the same month ever since, days keep adding onto January.

  • Enduring the End Times: As a conductor, the routine, mental strain and the impossible train dilemmas will eventually tire you out. The nightmares you will face are surely not the result of your own decisions.

  • Vintage Dieselpunk Atmosphere: Once set on your journey, listen to music on the gramophone and relax in your metal oil-stained cage. Fill in your lungs with the smoke molecules.

  • Cling to Hope: Be sure to water Hope before each journey. It is your only companion after all.

  • Secret Agenda?: There surely is no secret agenda. Praise His Holy Name, the Pontiff General!

IRON SANCTUARY is inspired by the genre defining IRON NEST and PVKK, the art direction of Dishonored and the atmosphere of BioShock.

Within the city, raise the giant drill miners and release the cart ways that fuel the IRON SANCTUARY. The fuel should last throughout your journey.



Demolished terrain, hellish fields, inhumane temperatures and various obstacles may be encountered on the route, causing problems on board. Secure the pressure valves, replace the broken pipe parts, ensure every mechanism is up to speed. Resume travel.

Rescue as many people as you can from the calamity. Choose your route wisely, as both distance and breakdown can result in stalling, and each day increases the death count.

After you made sure that the route is set, the tank refueled and the safety measures checked, enter the control pit and IGNITE THE ENGINE.

Safe travels, conductor - - God. Humanity. Salvation!

KEY FEATURES

  • Immersive Train Conducting: Maneuver the outworldly train behemoth, the IRON SANCTUARY, secured from the hell outside.

  • Alternate Apocalyptical Setting: After the end of the Great War, in the 1920s hell overlapped with Earth leading to countless suffering. You have been living the same month ever since, days keep adding onto January.

  • Enduring the End Times: As a conductor, the routine, mental strain and the impossible train dilemmas will eventually tire you out. The nightmares you will face are surely not the result of your own decisions.

  • Vintage Dieselpunk Atmosphere: Once set on your journey, listen to music on the gramophone and relax in your metal oil-stained cage. Fill in your lungs with the smoke molecules.

  • Cling to Hope: Be sure to water Hope before each journey. It is your only companion after all.

  • Secret Agenda?: There surely is no secret agenda. Praise His Holy Name, the Pontiff General!

IRON SANCTUARY is inspired by the genre defining IRON NEST and PVKK, the art direction of Dishonored and the atmosphere of BioShock.

store_data.about_the_game:
Tired of wandering through blank fog of war to scout enemy positions in traditional medieval strategy games? Lord Wars completely abandons this outdated design, bringing a brand-new tactical experience built around terrain shelter and dynamic weather shifts.

You can always view the full layout of the battlefield map, yet you may never fully grasp your rival’s troop arrangements. Hide your army deep within woods and hills, then launch sudden flanking assaults and backdoor raids the moment rain, blizzard or thick mist descends. These ever-changing weather conditions will narrow sightlines and disrupt ranged combat, letting you turn clear sight disadvantage into a devastating surprise strike.

Build your manor settlement, gather resources to erect military facilities, and upgrade your barracks step by step to churn out seasoned veteran and elite troops directly. Multiple production buildings operate simultaneously to speed up army formation, carrying forward the classic fast-paced resource management and troop spawning fun of timeless RTS works.

Every unit has clear counter relationships, so pure numerical advantage cannot guarantee victory. Strike at enemy supply lines and production buildings to cut off their troop reinforcement, break their defensive choke points and seize the upper hand in battle. A strict population cap prevents endless mindless unit spamming and tedious late-game resource grinding.

No drawn-out stalemates will drag on for hours. Each match is designed to reach a decisive end within an hour. Outthink opponents with ambushes and environmental tricks rather than just outproduce them economically. Challenge cunning AI opponents in single-player skirmishes, or compete head-to-head with other players in online multiplayer to claim dominance over the medieval fiefdoms.

store_data.about_the_game:
Buzzness Tycoon is a chill, cozy idle game where bees drift across a floating isometric meadow, gathering pollen from flowers and carrying it back to the hive to make honey. Spend your honey in the shop and climb the upgrade tree to unlock faster bees, bigger grids, labs, and prestige — then sit back and watch your little world hum along.

Key Features

  • Relaxing ambience: a slow ~5 minute day/night cycle with a gradient sky, drifting clouds, a rising and setting sun, a soft moon, and a twinkling starfield

  • Living world: bees bob and buzz with soft shadows, flowers sway and cast shadows in the breeze, the hive gently breathes, and pollen-laden bees glow

  • Fireflies: daytime pollen dust transforms into glowing fireflies at night

  • Procedural audio: a gentle synthesized music-box loop and soft pentatonic chimes when honey is delivered — no sample assets, everything is generated at startup

Controls

  • Mouse: drag to pan, scroll to zoom, click tiles/flowers/bubbles to interact, use the side panel to buy

  • B / M: activate Burst / Bloom labs (once unlocked)

  • N: mute / unmute audio

  • Esc: close popups / open the pause menu

  • Alt+Enter: toggle fullscreen

store_data.about_the_game:
Who Must You Defeat—the Demon King, or God?

One day, a voice from nowhere calls to you, drawing you into the story of girls who bear the names of birthstones.

On nights of the full moon, you are 《God》.

On nights of the new moon, you are the 《Demon King》.

Move freely between both sides,

and awaken the true power of the girls divided between light and darkness.

Advance Preview Scope

The current Steam advance preview includes:

  • God- and Demon-side story Chapters 1–3

  • Demon-side tower defense stages 1-1 through 1-10

  • God/Demon side switching, character growth, and 4v4 battles

  • The castle town, demon-castle prosperity, and taskbar-style companion

The following content is in development for the full release and is not included in the advance preview: Chapter 4 onward, TD 1-11 onward, the Magic Racetrack, the outside map/gathering/vehicles/garage, and seasonal event hubs.

A World That Grows While You Play

Keep a lightweight companion open beside your taskbar and check in between work—or another game. The God-side companion follows your pilgrimage and idle exploration, while the Demon-side companion tracks castle production and development.

You do not need to stay glued to the screen. Collect what has accumulated, set your next direction, and return to your day. When you want a more active session, open the full game for 4v4 battles, story chapters, and tower defense.

  • Two lightweight companions — Keep an eye on the God and Demon King sides, even side by side

  • Progress through short check-ins — Review exploration rewards, resources, and construction when it suits you

  • Growth that carries into the full game — Build momentum in the small window, then return for battles and story

A God at the Full Moon. A Demon King at the New Moon.

Two parcels arrive from a prize campaign he does not remember entering. Inside: two birthstones and a QR code.

On the night of the full moon, an ordinary young man is pulled into another world as a bodiless God. He resonates with the birthstone heroines, sharing their senses and awakening powers neither could wield alone. At the new moon, the same protagonist is called to a second role: the Demon King.

Are light and darkness truly the same as good and evil? The God meant to save the world enters the Demon Castle and orders construction instead of destruction. Even the “enemy” has a home worth protecting.

God Side — Raise the Twelve Envoys for 4v4 Battles

Recruit the Twelve Birthstone Envoys and shape their growth through levels, equipment, skills, and awakening. Build a team whose roles work together, then lead them into 4v4 battles.

  • Twelve memorable companions — Each birthstone brings a different personality, role, and story

  • Growth and team building — Combine levels, equipment, skills, and awakening

  • Costume customization — Choose seasonal and themed looks for your favorites

  • 4v4 battles — Plan your frontline, support, and reserves to build a team of your own

Demon Side — Build a Realm Worth Defending

Gather nine resources, construct facilities, and develop the castle town. Your Demon Castle is more than a battlefield: it is a living realm with homes to protect and a future to build.

  • Demon Castle Prosperity — Resource production, facilities, castle levels, and a branching development road

  • Castle town development — Visit specialized districts, develop facilities, and help the realm prosper

  • Star-Ring Defense — Spend DP to deploy characters and summoned units, then protect your cores against incoming waves

Twelve Birthstones. Two Faces of Fate.

Under the full moon stand the Twelve Envoys of Light. Under the new moon wait the Twelve Generals of Darkness. The same birthstones reveal different faces when their loyalties and destinies change.

Keep it small on busy days. Dive deep when you have time. Re:BirthStone is designed as two worlds that keep growing beside your everyday life.

store_data.about_the_game:
Dodge the Barrage. Turn the Tide with Devastating Skills.

BLUE SHIP is a fast-paced 2D vertical-scrolling shoot ’em up where powerful combat abilities are the key to surviving ever-changing bullet patterns.

Slip through dense barrages, then seize control of the screen with black holes, wide-area clears, and high-impact attacks that erase threats before they can close in.

Enemy formations and projectile behavior shift from run to run, so memorizing a single route will only take you so far. Read the battlefield, create your own openings, and decide whether to unleash a skill now or save it for the next wave.

Pilot ships with distinct combat styles across Story, Boss Practice, Time Attack, and Endless modes.

Short runs, instant retries, and tightly packed encounters keep the focus on what matters most: reading the chaos and breaking through it.

store_data.about_the_game:
CRAWL TOGETHER. FLY TOGETHER.

Until We Fly is an online co-op escape adventure for up to 8 players.

Become a tiny caterpillar and journey through frozen trails and untamed landscapes. A stage is cleared as soon as even one teammate reaches the goal, so work together to open a path and get someone across the finish line.

SURVIVE AS A TEAM

Slippery paths send you sliding, mud slows you down, and strange terrain may disable or even reverse your movement commands. Dodge moving obstacles, read the timing of flamethrowers, explosions, and shockwaves, and coordinate every dangerous crossing.

If a teammate goes down, follow their signal and rescue them. If everyone falls, the entire group must try again. Decide who leads, where to regroup, and when it is safe to move.

MASTER THE PATH

Activate switches, open doors, and use jump pads to cross dangerous gaps. Special terrain and interactive devices turn every route into a challenge of timing, coordination, and trust.

  • Online co-op for up to 8 players
  • A shared objective—get at least one teammate to the goal
  • Rescue downed teammates and keep the group moving
  • Slippery, fast, muddy, restricted, and reversed-control terrain
  • Moving obstacles, flamethrowers, explosions, and shockwaves
  • Doors, switches, and jump pads built around cooperative play

BUILD AND SHARE YOUR OWN ESCAPE ROUTES

Use the in-game Map Builder to create and test your own co-op escape maps. Paint paths, place obstacles, configure interactive devices, and publish your creations to the Steam Workshop.

Subscribe to maps made by other players and take on new challenges with your friends.

There are no weapons to master and no enemies to defeat. All you need is a clear path, good timing, and the determination to leave no caterpillar behind.

Each caterpillar that reaches the goal carries the whole team one step closer to flight.

ABOUT THIS GAME

NO THOUGHTS. JUST DODGE.

The feed is endless. Your attention span is not.

Take control of one extremely overworked braincell—or bring a second braincell along—and survive a neon storm of doomscroll phones, screaming notifications, weaponized lag, and nonstop chaos.

Collect Thought Crumbs, build combos, choose powerful upgrades, grab Mystery Orbs, and fight to keep your braincells online as the screen becomes increasingly unhinged.

PLAY SOLO OR WITH TWO BRAINCELLS

أنت طفلٌ عالق داخل منزل جدتك.

في البداية، يبدو كل شيء طبيعيًا... لكنك سرعان ما تكتشف أن أختك محبوسة في الطابق العلوي، وأن جدتك لم تعد كما كانت.

ابحث في أنحاء المنزل، واكشف السر الذي يختبئ خلف جدرانه قبل أن يفوت الأوان.

You are a child trapped inside your grandmother's house.

At first everything seems normal... but you soon learn that your sister is locked upstairs, and that your grandmother is no longer what she was.

Search the house and uncover the secret hiding behind its walls before it is too late.

...لكن كن حذرًا

.الحجة تسمع كل شيء

.إذا أسقطت شيئًا على الأرض، أو اصطدمت بالأثاث، أو مشيت فوق أرضية تصدر صوتًا، فسوف تعرف مكانك وتبدأ بالبحث عنك

.يمكنك الاختباء داخل الخزائن حتى ترحل، لكن لا تدعها تراك وأنت تدخل إليها

...but be careful

Al-Hajjah hears everything.

Drop something on the floor, walk into the furniture, or step on a board that creaks, and she will know where you are and come looking for you.

You can hide inside the wardrobes until she leaves — but don't let her see you getting in.

.استكشف غرف المنزل وممراته المظلمة

.ابحث عن المفاتيح والأدوات التي تساعدك على التقدم، وافتح الأبواب المغلقة، واستخدم البيئة من حولك لصالحك

.شغّل التلفاز لتشتيت الحجة، وفتّش الأدراج والخزائن، وافتح طريقك خطوةً بخطوة

...لكن تذكّر

.ليس كل باب يقود إلى النجاة

Explore the rooms of the house and its dark corridors.

Look for the keys and tools that carry you forward, open the locked doors, and turn what is around you to your advantage.

Put the television on to draw Al-Hajjah away, search the drawers and the cupboards, and open your way one step at a time.

...but remember

Not every door leads out alive.

.اكتشف حقيقة ما حدث لجدتك، وأنقذ أختك، وابحث عن طريق للخروج من المنزل قبل انتهاء الليل

...لن يكون الهروب سهلًا

.لكن ربما لا تكون النجاة هي الشيء الوحيد الذي ينتظرك خلف الباب الأخير

...حظًا موفقًا

.ستحتاج إليه

Find out the truth of what happened to your grandmother, save your sister, and find a way out of the house before the night is over.

...escaping will not be easy

But survival may not be the only thing waiting behind the last door.

...good luck

You are going to need it.

store_data.about_the_game:
One deck. One board. An endgame that has waited three thousand years to be finished.

Chess of the Hidden Gates fuses roguelike deckbuilding with the footwork of Chinese chess — every card in your hand is a move, and every move decides who gets taken.

Beyond numbers: position

This is no stand-and-trade card game. A beast’s blade falls on a square, not on your health bar — step aside and the hit means nothing; stand wrong and you’re surrounded. Read the board, bait your enemies, force the position you want. It isn’t about playing stronger cards. It’s about playing better chess.

Three pieces, three ways to play

  • Horse Master — chained leaps that build Momentum, spent in one explosive strike.

  • Pawn Commander — ground held is armor gained: stand Steadfast, unmoved as a mountain.

  • Cannon Adept — strike through a screening piece with Relay shots that cross the whole board.

The world is a board; all things are pieces

The battle of Zhuolu never ended — its endgame lies locked behind the Eight Gates. You are the last player, entering with a single deck: every card moves your piece. The knight leaps, the cannon strikes through a screen, the pawn crosses the river and never turns back. Your deck is your footwork; your footwork is your life.

What’s on the board

  • 125 cards across four rarities — each one a move, a kill, or a trap.

  • Three classes, three signature systems: Momentum burst, Steadfast defense, Relay artillery.

  • Thirty-odd beasts, each with a backstory, a temper, and a mechanic of its own.

  • Nine Star bosses across three acts, every one rewriting the rules — up to Chiyou’s final reckoning.

  • Reshuffled every run: terrain, threats, beasts, drops. No two runs inside the Eight Gates are alike.

  • A living bestiary: defeat a beast to unlock its legend, told in the voice of an old field journal.

Every enemy is a prisoner

The beasts of these mountains aren’t health bars — they’re captives of the thousand-year board. The wolves are the grudges of Zhuolu’s fallen soldiers; the foxes, a corrupted line of the sacred Qingqiu; the tree that blocks your path was planted to seal this prison and has guarded its gate ever since. Thirty-odd creatures, each with a history and a temper that forces you to read the board. Beyond the last gate, the Nine Stars rotate every run — a false healer who mends every lesser beast, a fire-star that burns the whole board through, and Tianfu, the fallen sage, who turns your own class’s cards against you. Fight to the end, and the remnant soul of Chiyou awaits — and your choice.

One table, one duel

The whole war fits on a single scholar’s desk — a lacquered board for a battlefield, carved figurines for pieces, incense smoke and candlelight pooling at the board’s edge. You lean over it the way you’d lean over a real game: a three-thousand-year endgame, taken up again under your hand.

store_data.about_the_game:
A rolling-block puzzle where your piece is a whole line of cubes. Roll it flat, stand it on end, break it or rejoin it, and turn the camera to find the way — then land the chain along the goal line to cover it.

It looks simple: tip a line of cubes across a grid until it lands on the goal. Then the level starts taking your line apart — and the real game shows up. Knowing when to break the chain, where to gather it back, and which way you're facing when you do is the whole thing.

A line that comes apart

Your chain won't roll into empty space, so you can never lose a cube by accident. Drive it into a wall, though, and it shears — the cubes that can't pass break off and wait behind you, ready to rejoin. Reshaping the line is how you fit it through the level.

The angle is a move
Standing and lying, the same chain reaches different squares. And rotating the camera isn't just a look — it turns which way you roll and decides which cubes break away when the line splits. The direction you face is a decision, not a view.

The board fights back
Some blocks don't take passengers: one destroys the cube that lands on it, another warps it into something new, and your line splits at the break. It's never random. When it goes wrong, the trap was always there to see.

Features

  • Your piece is a whole line, not one block — the twist everything else is built on.

  • Cover the goal line — slot your chain onto the goal line and the level clicks shut.

  • Camera rotation that changes the play — it turns your controls and decides which cubes break off.

  • Climb and descend — stand tall to go up, reconnect lower to come down.

  • Break and rebuild — shear the line against blocks, then gather the pieces back.

  • A board full of reactive tiles — destroy and transform your cubes, crumble underfoot, or trigger effects across the level.

  • Fully deterministic — no luck, no jank; when you fail, you can see exactly why.

  • Editor and mod.io — build your own levels and share them with the community.

  • Full controller support, remappable controls, color themes, and localization.

Plenty to solve, and the tools to make more
A handcrafted campaign that teaches each mechanic before it combines them — every level machine-checked solvable before it ships. When you run out, the editor and mod.io keep the puzzles coming.

Simple to roll, hard to line up.

4981130.name: I Was a Failed Day Trader Who Lost Everything, But After Being Reincarnated in Another World, My Textbook Technical Analysis Actually Works and Now I'm the Richest Man in the Kingdom!?

store_data.about_the_game:
The setup was right. The size was wrong. The truck was on time.

Ned Rose spent six years losing to machines that traded faster than thought. Then a delivery truck settled his final position, and he woke up in the Kingdom of Valdria: two moons overhead, a magic terminal in every pocket, and live candlestick charts glowing in every town square.

Here's the thing about Valdria. It has a national exchange, six hundred years of price records, brokers, clearinghouses, forward contracts. And not one single person who has ever computed a moving average. They trade on rumors. On omens. On what their fathers paid.

In a market like that, buy low RSI and sell high RSI isn't a strategy. It's a superpower.

Follow the whole ride, from ten sacks of barley to the richest man in the kingdom:

  • Start with nothing. Sixteen silver shields, a cracked secondhand slate, and a head full of dead knowledge that suddenly works.

  • Build a firm worth fighting for. A pawnshop prodigy who audits everything (including you), a gnome engineer building the world's first trading terminal, and a teenage front-runner who picks your pocket so well you hire him.

  • Face a market that learns. Copycats print garbled pamphlets of your method. A cult chants your own disclaimer back at you. Your easy edge dies the same slow death it died on Earth.

  • Survive the whale. Aldric Vane doesn't read markets. He arranges them. And he's quietly buying the one thing the entire kingdom needs to survive winter.

What makes it different:

  • Real trading, really explained. RSI, short squeezes, pump and dumps, position sizing, market corners. Every concept is woven into the story and accurate enough that traders will grin and newcomers will accidentally learn how markets work.

  • Authentic trader psychology. The 3 a.m. doubt, the revenge trade, the stop-loss you swear you won't move. If you've ever held a losing position, this story knows you.

  • A complete arc. Volume 1 tells a full story with a proper ending, plus a hook that will make you very impatient for Volume 2.

  • No status screens. No skill trees. No grinding. Just candlesticks, leverage, and the oldest boss fight in finance: your own hands.

A linear visual novel adapted faithfully from the novel. Sit back, read, and let the market come to you.

This is not financial advice.

store_data.about_the_game:
Meet your new desktop companion — a mischievous creature that lives directly on your screen, reacts to everything you do, and absolutely refuses to be ignored.

Desktop Gremlins is a transparent, always-on-top desktop pet that evolves as you spend time with it. Feed it, pet it, entertain it, and watch as a tiny slime gradually transforms into a powerful dark sorceress. Just don’t forget to take care of your gremlin — or be prepared to face the consequences!

🌱 Evolve Your Companion

Begin as a tiny slime and progress through four unique stages of evolution. Each character has its own appearance, animations, dialogue, and personality. Feeding, petting, and other interactions grant experience and help your gremlin evolve.

😈 Chaos Mode

Want to cause a little mayhem? Enable Chaos Mode and give your gremlin complete freedom. It can shake and move windows, rearrange desktop icons, spin your browser, flash the taskbar, and perform other unexpected pranks.

Your gremlin will make sure it gets noticed.

🎵 Music and Application Reactions

Your gremlin dances when it hears music and reacts differently when you open Steam, Discord, Visual Studio Code, Photoshop, and other applications. It carefully watches what you are doing and always has an opinion.

💬 A Living Personality

Enjoy hundreds of different lines in four languages:

• English
• Українська
• Русский
• 日本語

Your gremlin can be hungry, happy, sleepy, affectionate, or furious — and it will always make sure you know exactly how it feels.

🛠 Steam Workshop

Customize your gremlin with community-created sprite packs from the Steam Workshop. Subscribe to creations made by other players, download them directly through Steam, and apply them in the application.

Want to share your own character? The built-in upload tool validates the structure and dimensions of your sprites, then allows you to publish a complete sprite pack directly to the Steam Workshop.

Create your own gremlins, share them with the community, and discover new designs made by other users.

store_data.about_the_game:
HOT POT FOR THE DEAD is a PS1-style horror game set in a seemingly cozy late-night hot pot restaurant. Prepare hot pot, serve customers, and keep the restaurant running while dealing with unexpected events.

As you work through the late-night orders, unsettling customers begin arriving one after another. Find out who they really are.

Honest work

Listen to the regulars’ casual conversations as you work. Work hard, and your efforts are sure to be recognized. At least, that’s what your boss says.

Uncover the Truth

Why do the customers want you to keep working? As the seventh day draws closer, the truth begins to reveal itself.

Features

  • Run a hot pot restaurant and serve hot pot to your customers.

  • Complete seven shifts and uncover the truth behind an unsettling story.

  • An atmospheric, story-driven horror experience.

  • Approximately 1–2 hours of playtime.

4981280.name: The Hunt for the Lich King

store_data.about_the_game:
An unforgiving dungeon. A custom deck. Zero room for error.

Based on the acclaimed tabletop design Scoundrel by Zach Gage and Kurt Bieg, this digital adaptation sheds the limitations of a standard poker deck to bring you a fully-realized, atmospheric tactical roguelike. Every room is a hand of custom cards, and every card is a brutal choice: weaponize it, drink it, or fight it barehanded. There are no safe paths here—only calculated risks and sudden deaths.

Basic Rules

Each turn, you are dealt a "room" of four cards. To advance, you must confront or bypass them:

  • Monsters: Fight them barehanded and take direct damage, or slice them down with an equipped weapon. But fight smart—your weapon's durability decays, and it can only slay monsters weaker than the last one it killed.

  • Weapons: Arm yourself to mitigate damage. But equipping a new blade means discarding your current one, along with its combat history.

  • Potions: Drink to patch your wounds, but greed is fatal—only the first potion you consume in a room will heal you. The rest are wasted.

  • Fleeing: Cowardice is a resource. You can run from a room and shuffle it back into the deck, but you can never flee twice in a row.

Game Modes

  • Classic: The pure, unforgiving 44-card gauntlet.

  • Tutorial: Learn the delicate balance of weapons and potions before the dungeon breaks you.

store_data.about_the_game:
THE AWARD-WINNING CLASSIC, REMASTERED

Guide the twin princes of Babylon, Nasir and Blasir, on a quest to free their kingdom from an evil sorcerer. Freeze one twin into a stone statue — use him as a stepping stone or a weight on ancient mechanisms — while the other dashes, drills and battles through five hand-crafted worlds.

A PIECE OF GAMING HISTORY

Created in Baghdad in 1993 for the Commodore Amiga — the first commercial-quality video game made in Iraq — Babylonian Twins was lost to history until its acclaimed 2010 rebirth:

  • TouchArcade 4.5/5 — Game of the Week

  • PocketGamer Silver Award

  • GamePro 4.5/5

  • Featured by Apple ("Great Platformer") and Google (Staff Picks)

Now fully remastered for modern devices.

EXPLORE ANCIENT MESOPOTAMIA

  • 15 levels across 5 worlds: the Royal Prison, Procession Street, the Hanging Gardens, the Assyrian Palace and the Tower of Babylon

  • Outsmart traps and enemies with the unique twin-switch mechanic

  • Collect real Mesopotamian treasures in the artifact gallery — from the Royal Game of Ur to the Lion of Babylon

  • Original acclaimed soundtrack blending Middle Eastern themes

THE ORIGINAL 1993 GAME — INCLUDED

Every copy includes the complete, never-released 1993 Amiga original, fully playable from the main menu — a piece of gaming history, preserved. Only on Steam.

PREMIUM, THE WAY GAMES USED TO BE

  • Pay once — no ads, no in-app purchases, no account, works offline

  • Full controller support (Xbox controllers)

  • Play in 11 languages, including Arabic

  • Steam Cloud saves, achievements and leaderboards

576 BC. A kingdom in darkness. Two princes. One destiny.

store_data.about_the_game:
《问道凡尘》是一款融合文字叙事、回合制战斗与沙盒世界的修仙角色扮演游戏。你作为一个凡尘境界的普通人。探索随机生成的苍茫大陆，远渡无边海域发现新世界，加入或者建立自己的势力，让自己的皇朝亘古永存，厌倦征伐亦可创立修仙世家生儿育女颐养天年，结交各路修士，用术法超度路上的劫修，也可自己成为劫修给世界带来你的传奇，在这个时光流转无穷变化的修仙世界中走出自己的仙途。

核心特色

📜 复杂鲜活的修仙世界

每一处洞府、遗迹、坊市、仙城、宗门、皇朝、修仙世家都有故事等你的探索和发现。修仙者和妖兽不是任务公告板——他们会自主行动、彼此交互、追逐仇敌、结成联盟。所有的势力、人、物都是动态生成，每次新开游戏所有的一切都不相同，你说的话、做的选择，会改变这个世界。

🔮 完整的修仙成长体系

凡尘 → 炼气 → 筑基 → 金丹 → 元婴 → 化神……从感应天地灵气到凝结本命气，从铸就道基到凝结金丹、化婴成神。每个大境界有初/中/后/圆满四阶，突破瓶颈、抵御天劫、领悟天道法则——每一步都步步惊心，可能当场陨落，也可能延寿千载，与天争命。

🏛️ 势力经营与基地建设

加入势力或自创势力，万古宗门、盖世皇朝、修仙世家皆有你开始，建造藏经阁、炼丹房、炼器室、灵兽园、演武场。管理势力，发布任务，参与势力间的博弈与冲突，合纵联姻成就无上伟业。

💀 魂契与黑暗修仙

修仙不止有正道。在战斗中趁敌虚弱种下魂契或者以境界服人直接契约——吸收修为、夺取物品、榨干神魂。三条路：正道修行、魔道吞噬、亦正亦邪游走灰色地带。不过但行好事也需注意因果业火。

🌍 沙盒自由探索

大地图自由移动，发现宗门、皇朝、世家、仙城、坊市、秘境、遗迹。采集灵材、开辟洞府、采集本命灵气铸就无上道基。世界不以任务清单驱动——你想去哪就去哪，想做什么就做什么。修仙所谓无上自由，功法术法无穷无尽，主修辅修任你选择，亦可自创独门功法术法，争雄一世。

🐉 六种修仙技艺  

炼丹、炼器、符箓、阵法、御兽、灵植。你可以六艺全修成为全能宗师，也可以只取一道走到极致。不同技艺之间有交叉需求——炼丹师需要灵植材料，更需要炼器师铸造的无上丹炉，御兽师也需要炼丹师的丹药培育灵兽血脉。如果技艺难学，没有师承，也可瞎炼悟道，谁规定不能无师自通。

⚔️ 战术回合制术法战斗

store_data.detailed_description:
《问道凡尘》是一款融合文字叙事、回合制战斗与沙盒世界的修仙角色扮演游戏。你作为一个凡尘境界的普通人。探索随机生成的苍茫大陆，远渡无边海域发现新世界，加入或者建立自己的势力，让自己的皇朝亘古永存，厌倦征伐亦可创立修仙世家生儿育女颐养天年，结交各路修士，用术法超度路上的劫修，也可自己成为劫修给世界带来你的传奇，在这个时光流转无穷变化的修仙世界中走出自己的仙途。

store_data.about_the_game:
This is a world without a safe place.

Resources are depleted and wars continue. Humans, elves, orcs - all races are competing for living space, and sword light and magic can appear in the corners of the town at any time. Food shortage is so severe that even cannibalism among the same species is no longer rare. Humans became dominant by virtue of their numerical advantage and enslaved other races.

And those who are unwilling to participate in the war and only want to survive are unconsciously guided to a place - the Divine Tree settlement.

This may be the last peaceful place in the world. But how long can this peace last?

Ella, an ordinary elf girl. After human invasion of her homeland, she was abducted and sold, spending countless days and nights in the carriages of slave traders. A monster attack allowed her to escape by chance, and after waking up in the forest, she was taken to the divine tree settlement.

Here, she met the gentle elf Leia, the summoner Ringo, the young Cat Clan boy Cangliu, and other residents who had also lost everything.

But peace is short-lived.

The barrier of the divine tree settlement is failing. Human invaders, forest mutations, ancient ruins... Ella must leave this sanctuary and face the world that has shattered her countless times.

And this time, she is no longer alone.

▸ Magic based combat system

▸Royal Records and Skills

Consume Goza and MP to release powerful skills. Each skill can achieve a 'mastery' effect through repeated use - once mastered, it can be released without the need for a royal seal, increasing its power by 50%.

▸ Transformation System

Accumulate SP points during battles, and when full, transform into a wolf orc - attack becomes melee, attack speed is greatly increased, and transformation is released after a certain period of time.

▸​The nine magic attributes

none, wind, thunder, water, fire, earth, grass, light, and dark - each attribute has a unique effect: wind can eliminate gains, thunder can interrupt actions, water can add moisture, fire can cause burns, earth can add shields, grass can increase damage, light can purify negativity, and dark can reduce defense. There is a restraining relationship between attributes.

▸ City defense system

When exploring outside, the main city may come under attack. Timely return can trigger a city defense event - fight alongside NPCs and use pre arranged defense facilities to resist enemies. Successful defense can obtain materials; Failure leads to merchants hiding, rising prices, and the permanent disappearance of defense towers.

▸ Cultivation and Production

Upgrade and enhance HP, MP, ATK, and DEF. Explore and obtain equipment - weapons, emblems, ancient relics, magic stones, some of which can be strengthened. Consuming materials and currency at specific locations to produce imperial edicts, equipment, and defensive buildings.

store_data.about_the_game:
Grow Your Penguin Colony

Hatch adorable penguin eggs, care for them with patience, and watch your colony flourish.

Every new penguin brings fresh possibilities to the battlefield. Expand your colony, discover new strategies, and build an ever-growing force to withstand relentless waves of monsters.

Before every battle, carefully position your penguins and prepare for the next invasion.

Raise Penguins with Endless Possibilities

Every penguin can become something completely different.

Different Body Types – A hefty penguin that blocks every incoming projectile? Or a tiny little fighter?

Support Roles – Why not become a fisherman? Spend each day supplying food for the entire colony.

Machine Gunner – Stay behind the front line and unleash a storm of bullets.

Elemental Expert – Freeze, burn, or poison your enemies with powerful elemental attacks.

Freely Customize Your Roguelite Builds

Every piece of equipment can be removed, swapped, and experimented with. Discover which penguin has the greatest potential.

Collect more equipment throughout your voyage—there's never such a thing as too much loot.

Transfer attributes to another penguin, split your bullets into multiple projectiles, or suit up in heavy armor. The possibilities are yours to explore.

Every Voyage Is a New Adventure

No two journeys are the same.

Explore unique routes, discover different maps, and face unexpected encounters.

Every decision carries both opportunity and risk. Will you choose the safe route, or gamble everything for greater rewards?

Uncover the secrets hidden beneath this vast ocean... and discover what lies beyond.

store_data.about_the_game:
You’re Fired. Now You’re a Robot Vacuum.

AI was supposed to handle only routine work.
But when it begins taking on more sophisticated jobs, a software developer with thirty years of experience is laid off in the name of “AI transformation.”
While he’s still reeling, ACAPLA Inc. makes him an offer he can’t refuse.

“All our computing power is tied up with higher-level work. That leaves simple jobs like this to humans like you.”

After a career spent giving orders to machines, he must now become the machine—and take orders instead.

It’s Time for Humans to Replace AI

Robot Vacuum Simulator is a first-person job simulator that puts you in direct control of a robot vacuum.
Slip beneath furniture, hunt down the last dirty corner, and leave every room spotless and serene.

Watching the Dirt Disappear Is Its Own Reward

Every job comes with a floor-coverage target, stubborn stains, and an objective unique to that home.
Plan an efficient route through each room, watch grime vanish beneath your brushes, and decide for yourself when to call the job done.
Your rating and pay reflect what you actually accomplished.

Different Homes, Different Jobs

Clean everything from cozy studio apartments and lived-in family homes to sprawling mansions, multi-story houses, and industrial facilities.
A routine assignment can take an unexpected turn.
Pick up scattered trash, tackle a sink full of dishes, wipe stains from the walls, and sort out whatever trouble the pets have caused.

New Equipment Changes the Way You Work

Invest your hard-earned pay in speed upgrades, a robotic arm, a jetpack, and more.
Upgrades don’t just make the numbers go up—they unlock new interactions, new routes, and entirely new kinds of work.

Clock In. Get Promoted. Keep Rolling.

Choose an assignment at the work console, report back to your dock when the job is done, and climb the corporate ranks.
Behind the endless stream of cleaning jobs is a story about human labor in the age of advanced AI.
And ACAPLA Inc. proudly guarantees that every machine is operated by a real human.

Key Features

  • Ground-level first-person driving from the perspective of a robot vacuum
  • Visible before-and-after transformations and cleaning-coverage objectives
  • Handcrafted locations ranging from compact studios to multi-story homes and industrial facilities
  • Performance ratings, pay, corporate ranks, permanent upgrades, and multiple robot models
  • Extra messes, dishwashing, recycling, and a variety of household interactions

store_data.about_the_game:
The water is already at your ankles.

You wash ashore on an island that is going under. The ocean climbs, steadily and without pause, and it does not wait for you to be ready. The beach goes first. Then everything above it, one stretch of ground at a time, until only the peak is left.

You have about thirty minutes. Take what the island gives you, build something that floats, and be on it when the ground runs out.

An island that shrinks while you work

Every island is generated fresh, and nothing you need is in one place. The hull wants wood and stone. The sail wants fiber. The rigging wants what washes up on the shore and what grows in the open grass. So you climb, you cross, you come back down for the thing you forgot, and the tideline eats the ground behind you while you do it.

Chop, mine and haul raw resources. Craft them into a hull, a sail, a paddle and rope rigging, then into the boat itself. Drop the boat at the waterline and it is yours to board.

Survive the water

  • Drowning is real. Health and oxygen drain while you are under. Stay down too long and the island finishes what the flood started.

  • Nobody dies instantly. Go down and you get ninety seconds of bleeding out on the ground before it becomes permanent.

  • Shrines bring back the dead. Fall past that timer and you become a ghost, revivable only at a shrine, and a shrine under the waterline is a shrine nobody can reach.

  • A new island every time. Procedural terrain and resource placement, so there is no route to memorize.

  • Thirty minutes a round. Long enough to lose everything, short enough to immediately try again.

Alone, or with company

Play it solo as a race against the clock, where every log you carry and every minute you waste is entirely your own doing.

Or bring up to three other players. Revive each other, split the island between you, and cover ground no single survivor could. The first person to board the finished boat becomes captain, and the captain decides when to set sail. Wait, and everyone escapes together. Push off early, and the rest of them watch the shoreline shrink and read "You Were Left Behind."

Fists, axe, pickaxe and spear all swing at whatever is in front of you, and other players are not excluded from that. Proximity voice chat means you hear the people near you and lose them as they walk away, which is useful right up until it is the last thing you hear.

There is one boat and a finite amount of island.

Everything else is up to you.

  • Shrines bring back the dead. Fall past that timer and you become a ghost, revivable only at a shrine, and a shrine under the waterline is a shrine nobody can reach.

  • A new island every time. Procedural terrain and resource placement, so there is no route to memorize.

  • Thirty minutes a round. Long enough to lose everything, short enough to immediately try again.

Alone, or with company

Play it solo as a race against the clock, where every log you carry and every minute you waste is entirely your own doing.

Or bring up to three other players. Revive each other, split the island between you, and cover ground no single survivor could. The first person to board the finished boat becomes captain, and the captain decides when to set sail. Wait, and everyone escapes together. Push off early, and the rest of them watch the shoreline shrink and read "You Were Left Behind."

Fists, axe, pickaxe and spear all swing at whatever is in front of you, and other players are not excluded from that. Proximity voice chat means you hear the people near you and lose them as they walk away, which is useful right up until it is the last thing you hear.

There is one boat and a finite amount of island.

Everything else is up to you.

store_data.about_the_game:
You are no longer a child. It's time to leave home, and all you have is your grandfather's old RV. Answer the call of the open road. RV Life Sim is an open-world nomad survival adventure that brings together long-distance drives, wilderness exploration, and a mobile crafting economy. Work, earn money, craft, sell, trade, and survive! Chase the horizon, discover new cities, camp under the stars, head down to the city to buy new clothes or camping gear from the shopping mall, and build a self-sufficient life over time.

KEY FEATURES

🛣️ Your Home on Wheels and the Open Road Start your adventure by transforming an inherited old RV into your home on the road. Plan long routes across changing climates, keep your engine and mechanical parts in working order, and manage your fuel, food, rest, and trade throughout your journey.

🛠️ Craft, Trade, Survive Every kilometer has a cost, so turn your RV into your own business. Gather raw materials from nature, buy cheap resources like waste oil from towns, refine them into fuel, craft products inside your RV, and manage your cash, fuel, and supplies by trading with towns. Work to earn, or craft and trade to win!

🔧 Upgrade, Expand, Renew Reinvest the money you earn back into your RV. Add interior decorations, expand your storage space, and boost your engine for rough terrains. Once you save up enough, replace your grandfather's old RV with a newer model.

🛍️ Shop, Find Your Style Head to the city to buy new shoes and clothes from the shopping mall, and decorate your RV exactly to your taste.

🌲 Camp Under the Stars When the sun sets, set up camp anywhere you want in the vast wilderness. Pitch your tent, cook meals with what you've gathered, rest under the stars, and wake up to a brand-new horizon every single morning, featuring stunning, uninterrupted vistas that stretch as far as the eye can see.

---

👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 A FAMILY-FRIENDLY JOURNEY

RV Life Sim offers a peaceful, relaxing, and wholesome simulation designed for players of all ages. With no intense violence or stress, it is a perfect experience to enjoy at your own pace, making it suitable for the entire family.

🚗 FUTURE CO-OP ROAD TRIPS

While the initial release focuses entirely on a polished single-player experience, a multiplayer Co-op mode is actively planned for future updates. You will be able to invite your friends, manage your RV together, and share the ultimate road trip adventure!

store_data.about_the_game:
This game is intended for adults only and contains blood, horror, violence, and sexual content.

No AI was used in the creation of the writing, artwork, or music.

This game was originally created in Korean and translated using AI. The translation will be improved through future updates.

“I want to live in a world where no one curses my name.”

“I want to live in a world where everyone loves me.”

An audition for someone just like you—

Next Bright

The one who can save the world is you!

An audition offering an enormous cash prize to its participants—and despite never applying, you have been selected as one of the final TOP 10 contestants!

You awaken in an unfamiliar place, surrounded by unfamiliar people.

“But I can’t even sing, and I’m way too ordinary to become a celebrity...?”

What kind of hidden talent could someone as ordinary as “me” possibly possess?

As the increasingly suspicious audition continues, will “I” be able to survive until the end without being broken?

<WORLD>

In 20XX, mysterious creatures appeared, and people began dying in droves.

Nations collapsed, and war and violence consumed everyday life. Yet the force that finally brought it all under control was neither the government nor the military.

“An idol who brings happiness and laughter to the people!”

Appearing like a comet, <Light> possessed a mysterious power through their performances—one that could instantly captivate even the most miserable and violent of people. No one disliked Light. No—no one was capable of disliking Light! For the first time, people realized that a star could exist with no haters and no malicious comments: the first in history and the first in the world.

Ten years have passed since then. Danger still remains, but the world is gradually returning to normal.

Behind the restoration of peace stood a single entertainment agency. Its name was...

'StartLight.ENT'

Recently, the company has begun spending enormous sums of money to recruit people from all walks of life for a new production.

<GAME OVERVIEW>

1. A Wealth of Content!

Over 300,000 Korean characters of text, 229 CG illustrations, 57 background illustrations, standing character artwork for 18 main and supporting characters and 13 extras, Spine animations for the standing characters, and 16 BGM tracks.

Experience two years’ worth of high-quality content, created entirely by human hands.

2. A Familiar System That Never Gets in the Way!

No unintuitive “keywords,” no “clue-combination system” where you cannot even tell how the clues are related, and no hidden-object-style environment investigations. All you need are a pair of sturdy fingers!

There is no need to jump back and forth between multiple pages to solve the mystery. When an important choice determines the course of the story, the game provides `Relevant Keywords`.

Use the `Choice History` feature to bypass routes you have already selected, and use the `Skip` feature—available at normal and high speeds—to move quickly through previously read scenes.

And, of course, an Easy Mode is also available for players who simply want to enjoy the story!

Step into the perspectives of a diverse cast, each driven by their own desires and personal voids, and interact with a dangerous and mysterious world!

3. A Dangerous and Thrilling World!

Idols, auditions, an apocalypse—and slime monsters?

A fusion of bright and dark subject matter! [ANTI-ANTI] offers a new kind of horror. Experience psychological and visual terror that steadily closes in around you. Before long, the tension will have you sweating—and completely absorbed in its world!

4. Natural Encounters—and Romance!

Enough with stories made for romance, about nothing but romance, and driven entirely by romance!

[ANTI-ANTI] is not a traditional dating sim, but it contains a considerable amount of romance and mature content roughly equivalent to a 17+ rating.

Experience romances shaped by dynamic events and shifting emotions between a varied cast of characters. Pay close attention to the relationships they form when pushed to their absolute limits.

store_data.about_the_game:
The Mystery of Misty Mount is a 2D mystery puzzle-adventure game.

Story

One morning, Wang Di wakes up to find that his father has mysteriously turned into a parrot. As he digs deeper, he uncovers that the accident is linked to the disappearance of his father's old friend fifteen years ago.

Determined to save his father and uncover the truth, Wang Di sets off for Misty Mount. But this is no ordinary mountain. Strange phenomena, surreal beings, and clues about the missing friend pull him into an adventure far beyond his imagination.

Gameplay and key features

Players will guide Wang Di through various scenes, searching for clues and solving intricately designed puzzles.

  • Chinese Fantasy Aesthetic — Hand-drawn 2D art infused with classical Chinese elements, creating a mysterious and visually distinctive atmosphere.

  • Puzzle-Driven Narrative — Every puzzle is woven into the story. Solving them is the only way to move the plot forward.

CHUD CRUSADE is a third-person RPG where you can choose a human warrior, a zombie, a robot, a vampire, or an alien. Each will have its own abilities but also their own flaws. Right now it's terrible because I've only just started making it - but the mechanics are going in and they're taken directly from your favorite games.

So join me on this journey to Make Games Great Again!
