store_data.about_the_game:
RENDHELM — THE DRAGONSEA

An age ago the World-Wyrm fell from the heavens and struck the center of the world. Its body became the land. Its blood — the Ichor— became all magic. And the vast inland sea that filled the crater still holds the perfect shape of a dragon reared and rampant: jaws flung wide toward the west, tail curling over the northern waters, claws reaching into the south. No cartographer drew this. The world remembers the shape it was given.

Four thousand years later, in the black abyss at the sea's heart, the dragon's heart has begun to beat again. The veins of magic are surging; monsters bloat with stolen power; spells grow wilder by the year. They call it the Quickening — and no one knows whether it means the Wyrm is finally dying, or waking.

You are one human against a breaking world. Gather what allies fortune allows, grow strong, and slay the five dragons that stir in the Dragonsea — or die trying, as most do.

Rendhelm is a deep, lore-rich text RPG where every system feeds the next: the magic that makes you strong is the same magic that corrupts you, the gold that buys your power is the gold that buys back your life, and the sword in your hand is a story of everything you killed to forge it.

⚔ Advanced Text Combat

Command a field party of up to four against wolfpacks, warbands, and Quickening-born horrors. Combat is a turn-based dice clash — initiative decided by level and strength, every blow an attack roll against a defense roll, with critical hits, misses, and hard-earned victories. Distinct attack styles — blade, arrow, blast, unarmed, and claw — play by different rules, and a living bond-and-rage system means who you kill first matters as much as how: strike down the wrong enemy and a tight pack erupts in vengeance, while your own companions rage to avenge a fallen friend. Every fight is a puzzle of targeting, resource, and nerve.

✦ The Weaving — Magic That Answers to the Land

All magic is the dragon's blood seen through seven hues: frost, ember, vitalism, mire, sun, stone, and tide. Your power rises and falls with the ground beneath your feet — a fire-weaver is a god in the volcanic Emberwastes and nearly mute on the frozen Frostcrown — so where you fight matters as much as how. But the Ichor is the blood of a dying god, and it never gives freely. Reach past your limit and the magic backlashes into your own flesh. Draw too deep, too often, and you begin to become your element — a corruption called Taint that only grows crueler, and more seductively powerful, the further it spreads. Let it reach its end and you are Hollowed: no longer a person, no revival, your run over. There are only three sanctums in all the world that can cleanse you, and each charges more than raising the dead. Power always has a price — and you choose, every fight, whether to pay it.

🩸 Surge Cards — Instant Power, Mid-Clash

Collect Veinsurges: one-use surge cards of raw Ichor, played in a heartbeat's pause in the middle of a clash — a killing blast, a party-wide ward, a stolen turn, a legendary Dragonpulse. Seventy-five cards across the seven hues plus five escalating relics of the dragon's own blood. Cards scale to the fight so they never fall behind, hit harder in your homeland and in your attuned hue — and your enemies carry hidden decks of their own, so the pause cuts both ways.

🗡 Millions of Truly Unique Weapons, Armor & Artifacts

This is the beating heart of the loot. Nothing in Rendhelm is a fixed entry on a table. Every weapon is a stack of independently-rolled parts — base type, metal, haft, geometry, edge, workmanship, elemental imbuement, and affix — for over 8 million discrete weapon combinations, with more than a million for armor and hundreds of thousands for artifacts on top. Then continuous rolls — exact sharpness, damage magnitude, elemental percentage — layer over all of it, so the real space is effectively unlimited. You will pull weapons, armor, and charms that no other player will ever hold.

[]Loot scales to the kill — hunt deadlier things to unlock better metals, higher rarity, and richer elemental imbues. The perfect drop is always one harder kill away.[]Chase the roll — climb the Crude → Common → Fine → Superior → Masterwork → Exquisite → Legendary ladder, where each tier is worth roughly ten times the last and a god-rolled blade is worth a fortune.[]Three pillars of gear — weapons across sixteen-plus base types, a full suit of armor from featherlight caster-cloth to legendary dragon-plate, and artifact charms (belts, rings, necklaces, earrings, sashes) that tilt your stats, speed, and elemental defenses.[]Every weapon is attuned to a hue — so the blade you swing is also part of your magic build, and a lucky drop can rewrite how you fight.

🔨 The Forge — Salvage, Enhance, and Gamble for Greatness

Most drops aren't meant to be swung — they're meant to be broken down. Salvage unwanted gear into raw materials — keenstone to sharpen an edge, granite to add crushing weight, furnace-smelted lava and frost-brine and auric acid to raise a weapon's fire, frost, or lightning — then tinker those materials into the gear you love to make it genuinely better.

But enhancement is a risk-versus-reward gamble, not a guarantee. Each item holds only a limited number of upgrade slots — one on Crude gear, up to seven on a Legendary. Every tinker is a skill check: the higher you've ground your crafting skills, the better your odds and the bigger the bonus — but fail, and you lose the material; botch a high-tier item and you can burn a precious slot for good. Each successive upgrade on the same item demands more skill and gives a little less, so a truly perfected weapon is a long, deliberate, nerve-testing project — and a masterpiece you built yourself, one calculated risk at a time.

🐾 Companions & the Kleffons

You don't have to face the Dragonsea alone. Recruit human companions across a spread of classes — Warrior, Ranger, Assassin, Monk, and weavers of every hue — and win over the Kleffons, clever tailed creatures that roll their own size, wits, and opinion of humankind at the start of every game. Some adore you on sight; some almost hate you. Spare a healer at the edge of death and it may follow you home. Every party you build is one this world has never seen before.

🦅 Death Is Not the End — the Vesper Hawk

Bind a Vesper hawk, the ash-grey courier-bird that never sets foot on the battlefield — which is exactly why it survives when your whole party does not. When everyone falls, the hawk carries your ashes home to the temple at Cindralax for the Reckoning: a solemn, blood-red revival where you buy your lives back from your bank — yourself first, then each companion one at a time, knowing any soul you can't afford right now is lost forever. Meanwhile your gear drops as a death cache on the very ground you died on — and what killed you decides what you lose. Mindless beasts leave it all; cunning, gear-hungry raiders loot up to half and walk off wearing your finest steel. A red skull marks each death site on your map, and every wipe becomes a quest: retrace your steps, reclaim your cache, and hunt down the thieves to win your treasures back.

🏦 One World, One Vault

Every town's bank opens the same shared stash — one gold pool, one item vault, reachable from anywhere you hold a link. And it's more than storage: your banked gold is the only gold that can raise your fallen company, while the coin in your pocket dies where you fall. Bank hard before a dangerous run — the vault is your lifeline.

🌍 A World on the Edge of War

Travel the overland King's Roads that ring the Dragonsea, between great kindred cities and a scatter of market towns, each its own small world. Eight peoples circle the sea — a hungry human kingdom reaching for magic that was never theirs, stone-holds nursing inherited grudges, sea-priests split over whether to wake their god or let it die gently, desert star-readers gone silent, and cults that would drown the world to hasten the end. Earn reputation or make enemies; delve ruins the Quickening has stirred, where the dead climb from sand and black water; and take your place in the crises that will decide the age.

♾ No Two Journeys Alike

Per-game randomization reshapes your companions, your cards, and the threats you face. Near-infinite loot means your perfect weapon is always one more kill away. The factions you help or hinder bend the world around you. And in the end, standing over the beating heart of a fallen god, you may be the one who decides what it does next.

Rendhelm — where the world is the body of a dragon, and the dragon is beginning to stir.

KEY FEATURES (short bullet list — for the store's feature strip)

A world built on a dead god — the sea itself is shaped like the dragon whose corpse became the land, and its blood is the source of all magic.

Advanced tactical text combat — dice-clash battles, five attack styles, initiative, criticals, and a bond-and-rage system where targeting is everything.

Magic that corrupts as it empowers — seven hues bound to the land, backlash, and a Taint track that can end your run as the Hollowed if you push too far.

75 instant-cast surge cards — play them mid-clash; enemies carry hidden decks too.

Millions of truly unique weapons, armor & artifacts — over 8 million weapon combinations, a million-plus for armor, and continuous rolls that make every item one of a kind.

A risk-vs-reward forge — salvage loot into materials and gamble skill checks to enhance your favorite gear, where a botch can cost you the best piece of gear you've ever seen.  ..How greedy will you get to craft the best damn weapon or shield anyone has ever witnessed in Rendhelm?

Recruit companions and win over the Kleffons — rolled fresh every game, from devoted allies to bands that hunt you.

Death is a quest, not a game-over — the Vesper hawk, the Reckoning revival, and a death cache your killers may loot and you must reclaim.

A living world on the edge of war — eight peoples, shifting factions, deadly ruins, and five dragons to slay to win.

🌙 We all have questions we want answered. 🌙

Some keep us up at night.

Some are completely unhinged.

And some we definitely shouldn’t ask, but we do anyway.

🕯️ Baba knows... 🕯️

Baba Knows is an atmospheric tarot experience where you whisper your question into the darkness and watch three cards drift onto a candlelit table in a haunting ritual.

The flames flicker. The cards turn. Then Baba speaks.

Her interpretations are cryptic, occasionally savage, sometimes comforting, and often a little too accurate.

Whether your question is profound, pathetic, romantic, ridiculous, filthy, or somewhere between existential dread and "Should I text my ex?" - Baba has an answer. She's seen it all.

She judges no one. She only reads.

🪐 Features 🪐

  • Ask Baba a question in your own words.

  • Receive a three-card tarot reading from the Major Arcana.

  • Watch the cards drift, turn, and reveal themselves in a candlelit 3D ritual.

  • Listen as Baba interprets every card before delivering her final answer.

  • Ask serious, strange, funny, romantic, embarrassing, or completely inappropriate questions.

  • Enjoy short ritual-like sessions built around atmosphere and suspense.

  • The cards reveal a path, not a destiny.

Some are completely unhinged.

The flames flicker. The cards turn. Then Baba speaks.

Her interpretations are cryptic, occasionally savage, sometimes comforting, and often a little too accurate.

  • The cards reveal a path, not a destiny.
store_data.short_description: Ask Baba anything. From life's biggest decisions to your most questionable impulses, Baba reads the cards with uncanny confidence, sharp wit, and leaves you wondering what to do next.

store_data.about_the_game:
Kingdom TD: Draft Your Demise turns the tower-defense economy inside out. Before every wave, choose the enemies you will face. Safer cards keep the road manageable. Greedier picks bring tougher creatures and deadlier combinations—but pay the gold your defenses need to grow.

Every wave is a decision. Every decision is one you’ll have to survive.

Build each incoming wave from enemy cards with visible threat, health, count, movement, and payout. Meet the minimum danger, then decide how much farther to push. Mix archetypes, account for affixes, and prepare for bosses in the coming waves.

Planning is untimed. Spend your earnings to place, upgrade, or sell towers, then shape routes from active gates to the Campfire. Your choices in the draft determine which defenses—and which roads—will hold.

Your mounted rider is a mobile support unit, not a traditional combat hero. Move between fronts, attune nearby towers for a temporary boost, and draw dropped gold into reach while the wave unfolds. Positioning can rescue a weak flank, but one rider cannot be everywhere.

Ride across eight regions, from open grasslands and stormbound mountains to drowned marshes, haunted roads, deep dungeons, and volcanic wastes. Campaign landmarks open battles, challenges, quests, tower records, enemy discoveries, and permanent progression.

The campaign road is the beginning of the game, not the end of it,

  • Take on authored Challenges with locked layouts, restricted tower rosters, and special rewards.

  • Push fixed-seed Endless maps and compare runs under consistent rules.

  • Spend War Coins on persistent tower skill trees.

  • Develop the rider's Hero Path and equip earned abilities.

  • Discover enemy cards in the Monster Codex and track tower records at the Watchtower.

  • Face Normal, Hard, and Legendary difficulties with additional rewards for clearing higher difficulties.

Draft for the gold you want. Build for the threat you chose. Hold the Campfire through the final boss of the portal —or see how long your decisions survive in Endless.

store_data.about_the_game:
Witch's Cabin Cleanup is a cozy organizing simulator about putting a cluttered witch's cabin back in order. Sort 5,313 curios across 6 rooms: the apothecary, the library, the greenhouse, the ritual chamber, the familiar's den, and more. All at your own pace.

A Relaxing Witch's Cabin Organizing Simulator
The cabin is a mess, and the magic only made it worse. Return everything to its proper shelf at your own pace, with no timers and no pressure.


Pick up each item: a potion vial, a loose spellbook, or a jar of moth wings, find the room and shelf it belongs on, and set it in place. Work through the cabin one shelf at a time.


Earn upgrades as you play. Move faster, reach farther, and unlock a few small spells: a levitation charm, a banishing wand, that make tidying the cabin quicker.


Cluttered shelves fill with neat rows of labelled jars, and the tangled herb rack settles into order. Each finished room shows clear progress.

Key Features

  • Sort more than 5,300 curios across 6 rooms of a witch's cabin

  • Simple gameplay: pick things up and put them back where they belong

  • Skill upgrades for speed and reach, plus a few magical abilities

  • No time limits and no game over. A relaxed pace you set yourself

store_data.about_the_game:
You run a small shop that buys, fixes up, and sells old games.

Most of the time, that's exactly what it is. You track down cartridges and consoles, clean up the rough ones, price them, and put them on the shelf. You hire a few people, cover the rent, and every so often watch a Pretendo Wave U sit in the window for a month because nobody wants one.

What the game actually cares about isn't the money. You can run the place like a shark, overcharge everyone and work your staff to the bone, and you'll turn a profit that goes nowhere. What counts is Influence, and there are only two ways to earn it: preserving games and treating people decently. Fair prices, a shelf you've genuinely restored, staff you haven't burned out. Turning a ruthless profit isn't on the list.

Influence is what lets you change the industry's history.

Leave it alone and everything plays out the way it really did. Catari runs out of money and folds. Zega gives up on hardware. One company after another quietly disappears, each on the schedule it actually died on. There's no villain and no countdown the game made up. It's just what happened.

But preserve a company's whole catalog, then sit down with the people who ran it and spend your Influence making the case, and you can buy them another shot. A version of events where they never went under. Save one and things start showing up on your shelves that never existed: the console that company would have built next, and the games that would have come with it. A history you wrote instead of the one we got.

Co-op (coming after launch)

You can do all of this with friends, and you don't have to be online at the same time to do it. Everyone runs their own store at their own pace. When you finish a week, whatever you pulled off, like the makers you saved, the Influence you banked, the collections you closed out gets added to one shared timeline the whole group is working on. You might play on a Tuesday night and a friend on Sunday morning; the timeline moves along either way, and you'll see each other's shops as postcards. One history, nobody has to sync up.

Get your favorites through and it's a good run. Get all of them through and you've mastered it.

It's a solo project, one person doing the code, the design, the art, and the music.

store_data.about_the_game:
Tail and Chaos is a colorful top-down action roguelite about a caravan of meerkats making its way through a living, dangerous world.

Choose one of three heroes, assemble a deadly combination of weapons and upgrades, and survive until the end of a 30-minute act. Weapons attack automatically—you only need to keep moving, dodge danger, collect experience, and make decisions that shape the entire run.

BUILD YOUR LOADOUT

Fill eight shared slots with weapons and upgrades. Level them up, unlock synergies, and transform familiar attacks into powerful final forms. Every new choice can completely change the way you play.

CHOOSE YOUR PATH

The caravan encounters branching routes and events throughout its journey. Safer paths offer a chance to recover, while dangerous ones increase enemy pressure and promise richer rewards. The consequences of your choices last until the end of the act.

CONQUER THREE ACTS

Cross scorching dunes, a moonlit riverbed, and the harsh Plateau of Dawn. Each act features its own enemies, elite foes, events, and three bosses standing in the caravan's way.

EMBARK ON AN EXPEDITION

Link all three acts into one continuous journey. Choose a hero, a Caravan Law, and a rescued specialist for the entire Expedition. Rest between acts, carry one acquired item into your next build at level one, and resume your journey later from a saved camp. Each act starts with a fresh build, so that single carried item can shape everything that follows.

GROW YOUR CARAVAN

Earn coins, purchase permanent upgrades, complete achievements, and fill your encyclopedia. Every new victory unlocks the next chapter of the journey and expands the caravan's possibilities.

Features:

  • three heroes with different starting abilities;

  • eight shared slots for weapons and upgrades;

  • weapon levels, synergies, and evolutions;

  • three standalone 30-minute acts and a connected Expedition;

  • branching routes with clear risks and rewards;

  • Caravan Laws, rescued specialists, rest stops, and item carryover;

  • events, elite enemies, and bosses;

  • permanent progression, achievements, and an encyclopedia.

store_data.about_the_game:
NEON FORTRESS is an intense cyberpunk tower defense game where laser mechs, plasma turrets, and missile batteries clash across land, air, and sea in a neon-drenched post-industrial battlefield.

The dimensional rift has opened. Tanks roll across desert canyons, gunships scream through neon skies, and battleships emerge from the deep. As Commander, your mission is clear: hold the line. Build your defense. Light up the sky. Defend the NEON FORTRESS.

KEY FEATURES:

  • 8 DEFENSIVE TOWERS, 24 UPGRADE PATHS - Deploy the M134 Vulcan Minigun, M777 Howitzer, Cryo Launcher, M61 Vulcan AA, Railgun, M270 HIMARS, Command Radar, and Ammo Supply Depot. Every tower has two branching upgrade paths with three tiers each - choose raw firepower or specialized tactical upgrades to match your strategy.

  • 30 EPIC MISSIONS ACROSS 5 WAR MODES - Fight through 30 hand-crafted levels spanning five combat theaters: Land Warfare, Air Supremacy, Naval Operations, Land-Air Combined Arms, and Sea-Air Hybrid Warfare. From desert outposts and volcanic fortresses to cyber cityscapes, asteroid belts, and dimensional rifts - every theater demands a new strategy.

  • 5 DEVASTATING TACTICAL ABILITIES - Rain hell with Orbital Strikes, freeze entire battlefields with Time Freeze, inject emergency credits via Supply Drops, disable shields and stun waves with EMP Blasts, and unleash Tactical Nukes for total annihilation. Every ability has a cooldown - use them wisely.

  • DIVERSE ENEMY ARSENAL - Face over 20 enemy types across three domains: ground units (scout drones, assault infantry, heavy armor battalions, shield troopers, medics, phantoms, dreadnought mechs), aerial threats (attack helicopters, fighter jets, bombers, AC-130 gunships, sky fortresses), and naval enemies (patrol boats, submarines, battleships, hovercraft, aircraft carriers, leviathans). Each enemy type has unique behaviors and counters.

  • CYBERPUNK × POST-HEAVY-METAL AESTHETIC - Brushed metal UI with neon cyan/magenta glow effects, industrial-grade weapon designs, explosive elimination animations, and laser effects that sear the retina. Every muzzle flash, every explosion, every neon reflection is crafted for maximum visual impact.

  • 5 LANGUAGE SUPPORT - Full localization in English, 中文 (Simplified Chinese), Français, Italiano, and Español. Switch languages instantly in-game with no restart required.

  • AUTO-WAVE PROGRESSION - No manual wave starts. Enemies come at you non-stop across escalating difficulty tiers from Recruit to Endgame. 30 difficulty levels scale enemy HP, speed, spawn rates, and rewards. Adapt your defense or be overrun.

Are you ready to command the last line of defense? The fortress stands. The lights are on. The enemy is coming.

Build your defense. Light up the sky. Defend the NEON FORTRESS!

store_data.about_the_game:
Buried Apparition

Story Synopsis

You are a top excavator graduate short of money. With your mentor’s referral, you land a well-funded construction job paying 1000 yuan daily. Rumors say buried antiques under the ground can bring secret extra profit.

You start work full of hope, yet eerie paranormal incidents keep haunting you. Locals claim this land is the sacred dragon vein of the village clan. As digging continues, a shocking conspiracy hidden deep beneath the soil gradually unfolds.

Game Features

  • Authentic Chinese Folk Horror

    The plot is adapted from real ghost stories shared by construction workers and refined for immersive oriental horror.

  • Hyper-Realistic Visuals

    All models are built based on real construction site references to create a suffocating, creepy atmosphere.

  • Easy-to-learn Excavator Simulation

    Simple controls support full workflows: digging, dumping, leveling, compacting and parking.

  • Branching Storyline with Multiple Endings

    Dialogue and action choices test your greed, morality and fate, leading to totally different finales.

  • Open Site Exploration & Puzzle Solving

    Roam the whole construction zone, dig up talismans, journals and relics to reveal the dragon vein’s dark secret.

  • Multi-stance NPC Interaction

    Interact with characters holding conflicting motives. Every dialogue choice alters the main plot direction.

Suitable Players

Fans of Chinese folk dragon vein horror, branching puzzle games and atmospheric psychological horror without cheap jump scares.

Content Sharing Policy

All streamers and players may record gameplay, stream full playthroughs, and freely share footage, story analysis and fan creations.

store_data.about_the_game:
You have never had any real friends. Only classmates you talk to at school — and nowhere else. So you decide to try meeting someone online, a new and almost unexplored way of connecting with people. But reaching out to strangers makes you uncomfortable. Taking the first step has never been easy for you.

After days of scrolling through countless profiles, you come across Iris, a 16-year-old girl who shares all of your interests. She is looking for a friend too, because she feels lonely. It seems you've finally found the person you've been searching for all this time.

Will you find the courage to send her the first message?

Every reply shapes the conversation. Iris remembers what you say, and the dialogue gradually changes depending on the kind of person you choose to be. Sometimes a single careless message can change far more than it seems...

Iris is more than just a character with pre-written dialogue. She reacts to your words, her emotions change over time, and she gradually begins to trust you... or perhaps the opposite.

What awaits you:

  • A branching story where every reply matters

  • Iris's opinion of you evolves over time, influencing how the story unfolds

  • More than 20 endings — from the best ones to...

  • An interface inspired by computers of the 1990s

  • An original atmospheric soundtrack

  • And, of course, Iris herself, who has been waiting for your message

store_data.about_the_game:
Sort Them Ducks is a cozy organizing simulator where your goal is simple: pick up rubber ducks and place them on the correct shelves. Discover thousands of unique ducks, unlock helpful abilities, and transform a cluttered store into a perfectly organized collection—one duck at a time.

A Cozy Duck Sorting Simulator

Thousands of rubber ducks have been delivered, but they're completely mixed up. Pirate ducks, wizard ducks, astronauts, knights, chefs, dinosaurs, and many more are scattered throughout the store. It's your job to sort every duck into its proper category and bring order back to the shelves.

No rush. No pressure. Just ducks.

From Complete Chaos to Perfect Order

Every shelf starts empty, and ducks are everywhere.

As you organize the store, shelves slowly fill with colorful collections, making every section feel more complete. Watching the store transform from a mess into a perfectly organized display is satisfying every step of the way.

Collect, Sort, Repeat

Pick up ducks from around the store, identify their category, and place them on the correct shelf.

The better you know your ducks, the faster you'll organize the store. Every correctly sorted duck earns money to help you improve your abilities.

Upgrade Your Duck Sorting Skills

Unlock powerful upgrades that make organizing even more satisfying.

Carry more ducks at once, move faster, highlight matching ducks, reveal the correct shelf, automatically collect nearby ducks, and unlock even more abilities as your collection grows.

Thousands of Ducks to Discover

With over 4,000 unique rubber ducks, every shelf offers something new.

Complete themed collections, learn each category, and enjoy filling the store with colorful displays of quirky ducks.

Key Features

🦆 Sort over 4,000 unique rubber ducks into their correct shelves.

🏪 Organize a colorful duck store filled with themed collections.

💰 Earn money for every correctly sorted duck.

⭐ Unlock upgrades that improve carrying, movement, searching, and organization.

📚 Discover hundreds of duck categories and complete every shelf.

🎮 Relaxing, satisfying gameplay with no time limits or penalties.

✨ Watch the store transform from complete chaos into a perfectly organized duck paradise.

Look. I brought you here. Do NOT ask how I got you inside the simulation, okay? It works. You are in there. That is all that matters.

​My name is Gregory (some people call me Minky, but DO NOT call me that). I built this place because... well, I needed someone to play with. I never really had friends, so I made my own games for us to play!

​It is very scary, very advanced, and completely custom-made. Ignore the missing ceiling and the rain with lightning coming from above the walls. It is an aesthetic choice, okay? I programmed it myself!

​HOW TO PLAY (IT IS VERY SIMPLE LOGIC):

​You start in the main house. There are doors on the left and right. Click a door, complete my challenge, come back, and the door stays open so you can progress. Easy!

store_data.about_the_game:
Double Trouble is a fast-paced erotic 2D detective visual novel where you play as two protagonists, each with their own abilities and storylines. Turn-based battles, character progression, side quests, and multiple endings await!

Oh, and of course... plenty of characters to fight, interrogate, and maybe even have relationships with!

You play as two detectives bound by the same curse and the same fate!

Long ago, a mysterious witch cursed two children, linking their destinies forever. Lumin, an energetic battle mage, turns to stone with the final ray of the setting sun. Nox, a sarcastic and cunning necromancer, transforms back from a frozen granite statue and remains "alive" until dawn.

Every day, Nox and Lumin trade places. Lumin has not seen the stars at night in years and no longer knows the solitude of the darkness, while Nox has long forgotten the sound of busy morning streets and the feeling of sunlight on his skin.

To find the witch and break their curse, they became detectives in a strange magical world filled with dangerous and mysterious creatures. With every case they solved, they came closer to catching the immortal villain. However... under unusual circumstances, she found them first and gave them an ultimatum.

They must help her solve a mystery of her own within 30 days, before the Day of Convergence, when the Moon and Sun become one. Otherwise... they will remain cursed forever!

Time is running out, so explore locations, gather clues, ask even the most intimate questions, and, of course, conduct some very thorough interrogations!

Remember, every day matters! You have 30 in-game days to gather all the evidence, complete every suspect's storyline, and unlock the good ending, so do not waste any time!

Once the sun rises, you will no longer be able to use Nox or his abilities. However, sometimes even the switch between the two protagonists can be used to your advantage, allowing them to conduct an "interrogation" together!

And do not forget how important it is to collect story items and evidence. Without them, you will not be able to unlock new dialogue options or add more variety to your interactive interrogation sex scenes!

Level up your characters and adapt their abilities to different enemies. Sometimes it is better to use the sly and devious Nox, whose spells can strike from a distance, instead of the energetic, sun-powered Lumin, who always charges straight ahead.

Your opponents are cunning, and they will evolve alongside you!

One mistake, and you have made a mistake! Every defeat will affect not only the ending, but also what the post-battle sex scene looks like.

Evidence is not only found through dialogue. This is not just another visual novel! You will need to think, investigate, and analyze!

Whenever a new customer wanders into Nox's shop at night, you will need to choose the right artifact or help repair a cursed item. This may unlock a new event that appears on the map the following morning.

Serve and question customers as Nox, explore locations as Lumin, or change your strategy whenever the situation demands it!

Add the game to your wishlist now and help us make the project even bigger!

We are itching to get started!

store_data.about_the_game:
Beneath the earth, every path leads deeper.

The Deep Calls is a turn based Lovecraftian roguelite Dungeon Crawler built around deeply customizable heroes, punishing expeditions, and lasting consequences. Choose a Quest, assemble a party of up to three heroes, and enter a branching dungeon filled with monsters, treasure, strange encounters, and dangerous bargains.

Once you descend, there is no retreat. The only way home is through the dungeon Boss.

Shape Heroes Beyond a Single Class

Every hero can follow one of three distinct Disciplines, each offering a different starting skill set, combat role, and permanent bonus. Turn the same hero into a stalwart protector, reckless damage dealer, status specialist, healer, or something stranger.

As heroes progress, you can:

  • Unlock new Skills and powerful signature Powers.

  • Upgrade Skills and attributes using a shared pool of XP.

  • Mix learned abilities into custom combat loadouts.

  • Equip Weapons, Armor, Helms, and Charms with powerful benefits and dangerous drawbacks.

  • Carry a limited selection of consumables into each expedition.

  • Build around two Traits that alter stats, change individual Skills, or demand sacrifices in exchange for greater power.

No hero is confined to a single role. Their Discipline provides the foundation. Everything you unlock, equip, and endure determines what they ultimately become.

Forge Effects Together

The Forge is a system for combining mechanics and creating items that could not otherwise exist.

Place two forgeable consumables on the anvil to create a Strong Item containing the effects of both components. Combine different items to produce a flexible tool with multiple effects, or hammer identical components together to intensify their original effect. Strong Items can be returned to the Forge and combined again at a greater Gold cost, allowing valuable effects to be condensed into a single inventory slot.

Equipment can also be fused. The piece placed on the left side of the anvil determines the resulting Equipment type. The finished item inherits the full mechanical effects of both components, including stat bonuses, special triggers, resistances, penalties, and self inflicted consequences.

Transfer an Armor's resilience into a Weapon. Combine two complementary effects into the centerpiece of a specialized build. Stack raw power while accepting every drawback that came with it.

The Forge preserves the bad along with the good. Forged Equipment cannot be reforged, and certain rare objects cannot be placed on the anvil. Every final strike of the hammer matters.

Fight Alone and as a Party

Combat changes depending on what waits behind the next door.

Basic enemies are faced by your currently selected hero alone, testing the strength and independence of individual builds. Elite enemies and dungeon Bosses call the entire party into battle.

During party combat, heroes act in the order you arranged them before the enemy takes its turn. Party order determines when damage lands, when protection becomes available, and whether a wounded ally survives long enough to act.

Use direct attacks, defensive Skills, healing, party buffs, enemy debuffs, and damage over time effects such as Bleed, Burn, and Blight. Build Block to absorb incoming damage, strengthen persistent defenses, manipulate resistances, and combine hero abilities into strategies that no single character could execute alone.

Choose the Next Door

Each dungeon unfolds through branching corridors. Scouting can reveal what lies ahead, but many paths remain uncertain until you commit.

Your descent may lead to:

  • Solo and party combat.

  • Terrifying Horrors.

  • Camps and opportunities to recover.

  • Treasure caches and Equipment.

  • Merchants, surgeons, and black market traders.

  • Strange events with lasting rewards or consequences.

  • A final dungeon Boss barring the way home.

Your supplies are limited, health persists between battles, and the safest looking path is not always the one your current party is built to survive.

Accept Quests or Embrace the Challenge

Before embarking, choose a Quest or Challenge that changes what the expedition demands of you.

Quests introduce additional objectives. Defeat extra Horrors, avoid healing items, reach the boss in perfect condition, fight without Equipment, or deliver the final blow through damage over time. Success brings valuable rewards, while failure may cost Gold, XP, or other resources.

Challenges alter the dungeon itself. Enemies may begin with additional Strength, Block, regeneration, or resistances. Your heroes may enter every battle Bleeding, Blighted, Weakened, or starved of resources. Greater risks create new build problems and new reasons to return to the Forge.

Defeating dungeon bosses increases the Quest Level, strengthening future enemies and pushing your roster toward the Chapter Boss waiting below.

Return Home If You Can

Between expeditions, return to the haunted house and prepare for the next descent.

Train heroes in the Gym, grow consumables in the Garden, purchase supplies and equipment, exchange unwanted Traits, unlock new Skills and Powers, and bring hard won loot to the Forge. Every successful expedition expands the possibilities available for the next party.

Heroes are not disposable pieces. When a hero dies, their unlocks and upgrades are lost, and they must be found again before they can return to your roster.

Build boldly. Forge carefully. When the Deep calls, make sure the heroes you created are ready to answer.

store_data.about_the_game:
For centuries, the great kingdoms of the realm have squabbled. Humans, dwarves, and elves remain locked in bitter rivalries, focused on ancient grudges rather than the borders of their lands. But while the alliance fractured, a dark tide gathered in the northern wastelands.

The goblin tribes, once scattered and broken, have united under a single, ruthless banner. Now, an endless horde is descending upon the fertile lands, intent on burning everything in its path. To survive the coming onslaught, the bickering factions must put aside their differences and stand as one.

The fate of the world rests in your hands. Take command, build your defenses, and lead the final alliance against the goblin tide.

Key Features

  • Take control of human knights, elven archers, and dwarven riflemen. Combine the unique strengths and magical abilities of the fractured realms to counter the endless goblin swarms.

  • Gather vital resources, expand your territory, and manage your economy to defend and conquer.

  • Position your armies carefully, utilize the terrain to your advantage, and unleash devastating magic in fast-paced, top-down battles.

For centuries, the great kingdoms of the realm have squabbled. Humans, dwarves, and elves remain locked in bitter rivalries, focused on ancient grudges rather than the borders of their lands. But while the alliance fractured, a dark tide gathered in the northern wastelands.

The goblin tribes, once scattered and broken, have united under a single, ruthless banner. Now, an endless horde is descending upon the fertile lands, intent on burning everything in its path. To survive the coming onslaught, the bickering factions must put aside their differences and stand as one.

The fate of the world rests in your hands. Take command, build your defenses, and lead the final alliance against the goblin tide.

Key Features

  • Take control of human knights, elven archers, and dwarven riflemen. Combine the unique strengths and magical abilities of the fractured realms to counter the endless goblin swarms.

  • Gather vital resources, expand your territory, and manage your economy to defend and conquer.

  • Position your armies carefully, utilize the terrain to your advantage, and unleash devastating magic in fast-paced, top-down battles.

  • Explore a high-fantasy setting brought to life with charming, hand-crafted 2D pixel graphics by Pixel Frog Studio.

In this high-fantasy pixel art RTS, you must unite the fractured realms of humans, elves, and dwarves. Build your base, manage resources, and unleash powerful magic to defend your kingdom from the goblin horde.

store_data.about_the_game:
Fly the belt. Harvest the storm. Punch through the boss.

Somewhere out past the shipping lanes, a permanent storm rakes an asteroid belt, and every strike leaves behind Belt Fulgurite, the most valuable material in the sector. You want it. So does a territorial faction of rival harvesters and pirates who consider the belt theirs.

Rogue Belt is a compact top-down space roguelite. Each run is a self-contained ten-minute harvest: pick a ship, pick a weapon, and fly into the storm. Crack asteroids for Fulgurite, fight the rival ships hunting you, grab an upgrade every minute, and punch through the boss guarding the exit. Escape with your haul and the run pays out.

Then you spend what you brought back. Grab your new ships, new weapons, persistent upgrades and go in again.

The loop is simple. The moment-to-moment is not.

Fly the way you want to fight

Rogue Belt has multiple pilotable ships spread across three distinct flight archetypes, and they don't just look different, they play different:

  • Drift Thrust. Classic Newtonian-inspired space flight. Thrust forward, rotate, and manage your momentum. Expressive, a little slippery, and skill-based.

  • Heading Lock. Inertialess movement along your facing. Direct, deliberate, and readable; trade drift for hard directional control.

  • Gunship Strafe. Move freely in any direction while your weapon auto-targets the nearest enemy in range. A tactical platform where positioning matters more than aim.

Each ship inside an archetype is tuned differently. One might be lighter and sharper, another slower and tougher, another comes with a beefy reactor for more powerful weapons. Picking your ship sets the whole feel of the run.

Build your loadout before you launch

Every run starts with real choices:

  • Pick your ship. Flight model, durability, reactor capacity, and a unique active ability.

  • Pick your primary weapon. Independent from your ship, mix and match your setup freely. Heavier weapons fire in shorter bursts on lighter reactors; higher-output ships sustain longer.

  • Pick your route. Choose which boss stands between you and the exit. Beat one, and the next one unlocks.

Every ship can equip every weapon. There are no hard class restrictions, just reactor tradeoffs that quietly reward smart pairings without banning weird ones.

Every minute deeper, a decision

At every one-minute mark, the belt pauses and you pick one upgrade from a small hand of choices. Weapons, shields, armor, hull, movement, utility... stack them however you want. There are no caps and no rarity tax in a single run, so you feel yourself getting meaningfully stronger while the storm gets meaningfully worse.

Then it's minute ten. Normal spawns stop. A boss warning ticks down. And whatever ship you built has to be enough to punch a hole out.

You die when you actually get outplayed, not because two rocks kissed you at the wrong frame.

Bosses that mean something

Each boss is the thing standing between you and getting out of the belt; telegraphed attacks, dedicated arenas, and combat states that ask you to use everything you built during the run. Bosses are also your progression spine: escape past one and you unlock a new ship or weapon to take back into the belt for the next route.

Roguelite runs, no wasted time

  • Ten minutes from entering the belt to the boss at the exit.

  • Restart instantly. Every run is self-contained.

  • Meta unlocks reward variety. New ships, new weapons, persistent upgrades, new bosses and enemies.

You’ve just taken the job as the sole night guard at the wildest facility in town: the Horny Asylum. Your mission is simple: watch the security feeds, keep order, and survive until dawn.

store_data.about_the_game:
FROM LAST PLACE TO CHAMPIONS

You have been hired to manage Mini FC—the weakest club in the league.

The players are struggling, morale is low, and expectations are even lower. Your task is simple: rebuild the team, overcome stronger opponents, and transform an underdog club into league champions.

Mini Soccer Manager is a compact 2D soccer management game that combines squad development, tactical decisions, club progression, and fast live match simulations without overwhelming you with enormous spreadsheets.

BUILD YOUR SQUAD

Choose your starting eleven, organize your substitutes and reserves, and find the right role for every player.

Every player has their own strengths, weaknesses, morale, fitness, potential, and position. Develop your current squad or search for new talent through free agents, the youth academy, and the wider transfer market.

  • Manage starters, substitutes, and reserves

  • Compare player attributes and potential

  • Swap players between squad positions

  • Sign free agents, youth prospects, and established players

  • Develop your team across multiple seasons

CREATE YOUR TACTICAL IDENTITY

Select a formation and build a tactical approach that suits your players.

Play patiently with short passes, attack directly, press high up the pitch, defend deep, or adjust your strategy to exploit the opposition.

  • Choose from multiple formations

  • Set attacking and defensive styles

  • Customize build-up play and team instructions

  • Prepare free-kick and set-piece plans

  • Change formations and tactics during matches

WATCH EVERY MATCH UNFOLD

Matches are played on a top-down 2D pitch where every player moves, passes, dribbles, tackles, shoots, and reacts according to their attributes, fitness, morale, formation, and tactical instructions.

You do not control the players directly. You are the coach.

Read the flow of the game, react to dangerous moments, make substitutions, and change your approach before the match slips away.

The simulation includes:

  • Two-half soccer matches

  • Passing, dribbling, tackles, and interceptions

  • Shots, saves, goals, and missed chances

  • Fouls, yellow cards, and red cards

  • Free kicks, corners, throw-ins, and goal kicks

  • Player stamina and performance changes

  • Live match events and statistics

TRAIN AND DEVELOP YOUR PLAYERS

Plan training sessions between fixtures to improve your squad.

Focus on attacking, defending, fitness, morale, or youth development. Players gain experience through both training and match performances, allowing your weakest prospects to grow into important members of the team.

Balance development with fitness. An exhausted star may not perform as well as a fully rested substitute.

COMPETE ACROSS FULL LEAGUE SEASONS

Face 19 fictional clubs in a complete home-and-away league season.

Every fixture matters. Other matches are simulated throughout the week, producing evolving standings, results, goal statistics, and top-scorer races.

  • 20 fictional clubs

  • 38 league matches per team

  • Home and away fixtures

  • Full league standings and statistics

  • League-wide results and top scorers

  • Season prizes based on final position

  • Continue playing through future seasons

MANAGE THE CLUB’S PROGRESS

Your influence extends beyond the pitch.

Track ticket sales, sponsorship income, player wages, weekly profits, and recent transactions. Use the club’s money to invest in facilities that provide permanent benefits.

Upgrade your:

  • Training Ground to improve player development

  • Medical Room to improve fitness recovery

  • Fan Stand to increase home-match income

You are the coach, not an accountant, so the financial system remains streamlined and focused on the decisions that matter.

A SMALLER, FASTER SOCCER MANAGER

Mini Soccer Manager is designed for players who enjoy management and tactical games but do not want a massive database-heavy simulation.

Prepare your team, play a match, develop your players, and move quickly into the next fixture. Each season brings new challenges, new transfer opportunities, and another chance to turn Mini FC into champions.

Can you take the worst team in the league all the way to the top?

store_data.about_the_game:
As stated in the overview, the playtime for this work is around 30 to 60 minutes—not including the time needed to unlock all endings.

Our protagonist is a girl named Utsu-chan, and you will act as her friend and guide. What you do together is more than just casual chat—it carries a deeper significance.

The game spans five days. Each day, you will hear rumors about different girls. "Truth" doesn't matter—all you need to do is decide what kind of voice to respond with to Utsu-chan inside the stall. Your accumulated choices will lead you to different endings.

This is a story about loneliness, misunderstanding, fragile emotions, and the bonds between girls—set among ceramics, stainless steel, and neurotransmitters.

・Warning:

This work contains descriptions and expressions that may be disturbing, including but not limited to school bullying, social anxiety, depressive tendencies, and inappropriate behavior by minors.

All content represents the protagonist's subjective experience and is not intended to encourage or glorify any such actions.

*This game currently supports Chinese only. English localizations are planned and will be added via a free update shortly after the initial release. Since I'm a solo developer, the translation will follow a bit later — thank you for your patience! The game is completely free, and once new languages are added, you'll get them automatically with no extra steps.

store_data.about_the_game:
Write Your Own Story in a Living World

Ashen Banners is a medieval fantasy sandbox where your destiny is yours to forge. Become a renowned hero in service of a kingdom, found your own empire, live as a mercenary, build a powerful trading company, or conquer the continent through force.

In a world where cities grow, populations evolve, and rival factions constantly compete for power, every campaign becomes a unique story shaped by your choices.

        

Explore a Living World

Travel across a vast continent filled with kingdoms, villages, bustling cities, mighty fortresses, and thriving trade routes. Discover new cultures, accept contracts, join wars, seek fortune through commerce, or simply forge your own path.

Every region has its own economy, population, and conflicts, creating a dynamic world that continues to evolve alongside your journey.

        

Recruit Followers and Grow Your Company

Every great adventure begins with only a handful of loyal companions.

Visit towns and cities to recruit new followers, hire mercenaries, discover skilled specialists, and prepare your company for the challenges ahead.

Every new recruit is more than just another soldier—they become part of your army's story.

        

Build Your Army

Create specialized squads for every battlefield.

Choose each squad's leader, assign warriors to the front or back lines, and organize formations capable of overcoming any challenge.

The strength of your army depends not only on its numbers, but on how you command it.

        

Plan Every Battle

Victory is earned long before the fighting begins.

Deploy your squads, study the terrain, and prepare your strategy before the first sword is drawn. The right formation can determine the fate of an entire army.

        

Watch Your Strategy Come to Life

Once battle begins, your soldiers execute the plans you've carefully prepared.

Every victory—or defeat—is the result of your decisions: army composition, positioning, equipment, leadership, and tactical planning.

Preparation is the key to victory.

        

Train and Evolve Your Soldiers

A humble villager can become a seasoned archer, an elite knight, a devoted priest, or a powerful mage.

As your soldiers survive battles and gain experience, they unlock new career paths, allowing you to build armies tailored to your own strategy.

Choose Your Own Path

  • Become a hero serving a kingdom.

  • Live as a mercenary, fighting for the highest bidder.

  • Build a prosperous trading company.

  • Found and rule your own kingdom.

  • Conquer the entire continent.

  • Or watch your empire crumble beneath rebellion and the rise of new factions.

In Ashen Banners, no two campaigns are ever the same.

store_data.about_the_game:
Read the realm. Shape the frontier. Break the rival capital.

Palisade is a fast single-player territorial strategy game played directly on geographically recognizable historical maps. Establish your capital, claim open land, develop roads and buildings, then commit armies where the frontier can support them.

Every order is visible on the battlefield. Follow advancing troop arrows, compare rival strength in the expanded standings, and watch borders shift as major and petty realms compete for the same ground.

Build a realm that can sustain a war

  • Place and upgrade settlements, castles, and marketplaces.

  • Connect structures with roads to strengthen your economy and troop capacity.

  • Draw Palisades across owned land to reinforce key approaches and stop cavalry.

  • Read terrain, coastlines, resources, and active fronts before committing.

Choose how to cross the frontier

Launch ordinary land campaigns, carve a fast corridor with Cavalry Charge, or plot a Naval Landing across open water. Routes and risks are previewed before you commit, while rival capitals turn the final advance into a fight for a lasting foothold.

Fight a global anthology

Lead five compact campaigns across sixteen scenarios: Northern Saga, Yellow Turban Rising, The Genpei War, Atlantic Voyage, and The Triple Alliance. Each campaign uses distinct geography, objectives, local realm layouts, and legacy choices while preserving the same readable core rules.

Build your own battle in Skirmish, or return for a deterministic Daily Chronicle generated from the date. Palisade is designed as a complete single-player strategy game; multiplayer is not included at launch. Palisade uses historical geography and carefully sourced regional context as a setting for an original strategy game. It does not claim to simulate every event, polity, or border at documentary scale.

store_data.about_the_game:
This village keeps an old custom: to secure its survival and prosperity, it offers the "unintelligent and unworthy" as sacrifice. This ritual-like typing duel is how that choice is made.

Only part of each column's card is revealed. Weave the longest word you can form from what's shown, before time runs out. Only the one who weaves the longest word is spared; everyone else takes damage equal to its length.

The longer the word woven, the greater the punishment inflicted — healing, a broken tool (your keyboard), doubled punishment, even an immediate sacrifice.

A single word can change your fate entirely. Stay "worthy" to the very end, and escape the sacrifice.

Key Features

  • Tension against the clock — everyone weaves and types within the time limit at once. Inspiration and typing speed decide who's "worthy"

  • Length-based bonus tiers — 5 to 10 letters, escalating from healing to an immediate sacrifice

  • Breakable keyboards — part of the punishment can break a key, narrowing the words you're able to form

  • Online multiplayer — private rooms with a room code, or quick match up to 4 players

  • Japanese & English support — full romaji-to-kana input handling, separate dictionaries per language

Join the Airborne, and join the fight against Communism!

(Side effects include caffeine addiction and pointing at things with a knife-hand.)

So much coffee. So much firepower. So much love for Democracy.

You’re Giga Joe, a highly trained (and slightly unhinged) paratrooper dropped behind enemy lines to cause as much damage as humanly possible. Blast through waves of Soviets, decimate Communist bosses, and leave a trail of pixelated destruction in this pure arcade run-and-gun.

15 minutes of explosive campaign chaos, then Endless mode when you’re ready to test yourself. With a driving soundtrack by Bert Cole, crisp pixel art, and, um, "enthusiastic" voice acting.

Features

  • Set in the world of the ttrpg Mörk Borg hack, Victory's Grave

  • Classic top-down run-and-gun gameplay inspired by the arcade greats

  • Tight campaign (~15 minutes) plus endless survival mode with scaling difficulty

  • Wide variety of enemies, challenging bosses, and explosive encounters

  • Powerful weapons and satisfying combat loop

  • Original score by Bert Cole

  • "Enthusiastic" voice acting

  • Fully offline – jump in and play anytime

  • Windows – play offline with no restrictions

store_data.about_the_game:
The shift has begun. Time to save the city!

Bad Dead Shift is a dynamic side-scrolling pixel shooter that blends intense action, level exploration, and chaotic zombie combat. The undead don’t just shuffle forward - they grab weapons, shoot back, surround you, and keep you moving constantly!

Knock a shotgun out of an infected’s hands with a powerful bat swing. Pick it up and clear the room. Out of ammo? No problem - hurl the empty gun straight into the next zombie’s face. Every second of combat is a choice between risk and mayhem.

Levels are built from rooms and corridors, where every door hides the unknown. A new room might reward you with rescued survivors... or a deadly ambush. And in dark basements, you'd better not linger - you never know who's waiting in the shadows.

Save survivors, unlock new hats, and change your playstyle. Cop, firefighter, cowboy, soldier, or even a magician - each hat changes the rules of battle and lets you approach levels in fresh new ways.

Want a real challenge? Jump into Arcade Mode and try to survive an endless night in a city that's already almost dead.

  • Armed zombies - The infected don't just charge ahead. They grab guns, shoot back, and turn every room into an unpredictable firefight.

  • Hit, knock, improvise - Charge your baseball bat, knock weapons out of enemies' hands, and use everything around you - even throw empty guns as a last resort to stay alive.

  • 30 dangerous levels - Open doors blindly, explore rooms, and descend into dark basements where a deadly ambush could be hiding behind every shadow.

  • Huge arsenal of crazy weapons - From the classic bat to miniguns, flamethrowers, and laser guns, each weapon changes the rhythm of combat.

  • Game-changing hats - Save survivors, unlock new looks, and pick bonuses that completely change your approach to clearing levels.

store_data.about_the_game:
Imperionis is a single-player tactical RPG in which you take the role of a Roman commander and lead a century through a military campaign in Gaul. The campaign lasts 150 in-game days, with three actions available each day. You decide whether to spend them on training, treatment, rest, camp development, or advancing along the route.

During the campaign, text-based events present several possible actions. Their outcomes depend on the commander’s attributes, the condition of the century, equipment, and a D20 roll. Your decisions affect health, morale, supplies, troop strength, and the conditions of future battles.

The commander and the century develop separately. The commander improves personal attributes and combat skills while acquiring weapons, armor, and travel equipment. The army unlocks new doctrines, orders, characters, and units, including legionaries, auxiliary infantry, ranged troops, cavalry, standard-bearers, scorpions, and onagers. Each troop branch earns its own veterancy and performs a distinct role within the battle group.

Key features:

  • turn-based battles on a hex grid featuring multiple controllable units, different attack types, and movement ranges, playable manually or through autobattle;

  • century development with new characters, troop types, orders, and tactical options to unlock;

  • separate veterancy progression for infantry, ranged troops, cavalry, standard-bearers, and siege crews;

  • varied objectives, including eliminating the enemy, holding a position, breaking through a formation, protecting a unit, and defeating an enemy commander;

  • personal duels against enemies who break through to the commander, using his attributes, combat skills, and equipment;

  • camp development and management of supplies, medicine, morale, and troop strength;

  • campaign-ending death or loss of the century, followed by a legacy system for future campaigns.

Check results, chosen development paths, unlocked units, and battle losses affect how the campaign unfolds. Both the century’s tactical battles and the commander’s personal duels can be played manually or resolved through autobattle.

store_data.about_the_game:
One more run. That's the whole game.

Fight waves of medieval hordes in first person, with up to three friends. Between waves you spend your gold at the shop. After every boss you pick one of three relics that bend the rules. Wipe, unlock something permanent, queue it up again.

The loop

Enemies camp around the map and you choose which fight to pick. Dawdle too long and the pressure clock wakes everything at once, faster and angrier than it was a minute ago. Clear the wave, crack the chest, sort your loot, vote to push on. A boss every five waves. Kill three of them and you've won. Then Endless mode asks if you really meant it.

Gear worth fighting over (except you can't)

Every drop is yours alone. Your loot is invisible to your friends, so nobody races you to the corpse and the group stays a group. Rarity decides how many affixes an item rolls and how spicy the rolls get, and the ceiling climbs every wave, so wave 12 loot makes wave 2 loot look like a costume. Want to trade anyway? Drop it on the ground like a gentleman.

Vendors with questionable ethics

After each boss a stall opens: the Blacksmith rerolls your gear until it's what you wanted it to be, or the Alchemist sells elixirs and a Mystery Tonic that permanently changes a random stat with zero refunds. And sometimes, mid-run, a Gambler just wanders in from parts unknown. You can guess how his prices work.

Abilities, picked at the worst possible time

Leveling up heals you to full and hands you a pick-one-of-three ability choice the moment things calm down. Stack up to four actives, feed them all from the same stamina pool that runs your dodges and swings, and decide mid-horde whether you can afford to cast anything at all.

Co-op that respects your evening

1 to 4 players, friends-only invites, no matchmaking queue. It's free, so the hardest part of getting your group together is already solved. Downed friends can be picked back up. Clutch revives are the best thing in the game, and I will not be taking questions.

What's actually in it

A run you can win, an Endless mode for people who don't believe in endings, six enemy types plus elite variants, bosses, personal loot with real itemization, ability builds, and milestone unlocks between runs. It's small on purpose and free on purpose. Some of the jank is load-bearing. If it's not for you, the uninstall button costs the same as the install button did.

Enemies camp around the map and you choose which fight to pick. Dawdle too long and the pressure clock wakes everything at once, faster and angrier than it was a minute ago. Clear the wave, crack the chest, sort your loot, vote to push on. A boss every five waves. Kill three of them and you've won. Then Endless mode asks if you really meant it.

Gear worth fighting over (except you can't)

Every drop is yours alone. Your loot is invisible to your friends, so nobody races you to the corpse and the group stays a group. Rarity decides how many affixes an item rolls and how spicy the rolls get, and the ceiling climbs every wave, so wave 12 loot makes wave 2 loot look like a costume. Want to trade anyway? Drop it on the ground like a gentleman.

Vendors with questionable ethics

After each boss a stall opens: the Blacksmith rerolls your gear until it's what you wanted it to be, or the Alchemist sells elixirs and a Mystery Tonic that permanently changes a random stat with zero refunds. And sometimes, mid-run, a Gambler just wanders in from parts unknown. You can guess how his prices work.

Abilities, picked at the worst possible time

Leveling up heals you to full and hands you a pick-one-of-three ability choice the moment things calm down. Stack up to four actives, feed them all from the same stamina pool that runs your dodges and swings, and decide mid-horde whether you can afford to cast anything at all.

Co-op that respects your evening

1 to 4 players, friends-only invites, no matchmaking queue. It's free, so the hardest part of getting your group together is already solved. Downed friends can be picked back up. Clutch revives are the best thing in the game, and I will not be taking questions.

What's actually in it

A run you can win, an Endless mode for people who don't believe in endings, six enemy types plus elite variants, bosses, personal loot with real itemization, ability builds, and milestone unlocks between runs. It's small on purpose and free on purpose. Some of the jank is load-bearing. If it's not for you, the uninstall button costs the same as the install button did.
store_data.short_description: Iron Wake is a free 1–4 player co-op action roguelike. Hold the line in first person against escalating medieval hordes, spend your gold between waves, and stack relics until your build gets ridiculous.

4993800.name: Out Of Order - A Vending Machine Roguelike

store_data.about_the_game:
Out of Order is a cozy roguelike deckbuilder about running a vending machine. Your stockroom is your deck, every day is one round of restocking, selling, and drafting new products. An increasing weekly quota decides whether your contract survives.

A run is twelve weeks at one venue. Stock the machine well and profit; stock it poorly and customers walk away, perishables spoil, and the weekly quota check ends the contract.

Each day you restock your vending machine from your stockroom, serve the day's customers, and choose one of three new products to add to your deck. Chocolate pays more next to drinks, an energy drink provides a bonus for whoever's next in line, and a pizza slice pays a bonus if it empties the entire machine. Survive all twelve weekly quota checks to win the run.

What's in the game:

- 50 food and drink products

- 25 venues, from a laundromat to an international airport, each with its own crowd, commission cut, and quota curve

- 27 customers with a variety of appetites. The cop only buys donuts

- 32 machine upgrades: neon signs, cooling, tip jars

- 69 feats that unlock venues, product bundles, upgrades, cabinet skins, and color themes

- Seeded runs (type in a seed, get the exact same run) and auto saves after every decision

- Full controller support

Running a machine means dealing with everything that can, and often does, go wrong. Slots jam, Cooling fails, and overnight break-ins cost you stock. Each venue brings its own trouble: rats at the zoo, pickpockets working the stadium crowd, power cuts at the aquarium. Weather can influence the day too. Storms and heat waves are forecast a day ahead, so you can plan and restock around them; card skimmers and tax audits happen with no warning. Every problem needs a decision: pay a technician to fix it right away, or repair it yourself for free while that part of the machine stays out of action for two days.

Occasionally you'll be offered a second vending machine at a new venue. Take on the extra contract, or decline and stay focused on the one you have.

No microtransactions. No real gambling. Just honest vending.

About the demo: The demo contains four-week runs at four venues, with a reduced product lineup. No breakdowns, no second machines, and progress doesn't carry into the full game.

store_data.about_the_game:
Dodge your way through three brutal levels of deadly enemies (and lasers) that kill you in an instant. Collect diamonds until you have enough to make it out alive. Can you dodge your way past everything and take down the final boss?

Dodge All the Things is a challenging single-player dodge 'em up, which is completely free due to its small scope. I hope the ratio of players rage-quitting to players finding joy in overcoming a hard challenge will not be too bad.

Although there are no in-game instructions for how to use a controller, you should be able to use an Xbox or Playstation controller just fine. With either the d-pad or left analog stick for movement, B/Circle for reset, and Menu/Options/Start for going back to the menu.

Hellscum Tactics features tactical turn-based battles centered on squad building and development while exploring dungeons. 

Help the unjustly condemned escape from hell.

The player must choose four hellspawn and utilize their unique abilities and tactics to defeat enemies in turn-based battles.

Between battles, the player levels up the characters by selecting new skills and boosting their stats.

The player must manage risk when choosing the paths to escape hell.

The hellspawn's health does not regenerate between battles, so the player must rely on healing potions found along the way and random events.

Game features:

-Choose a team of hellspawn with unique abilities and help them escape from hell.

-Combat is tactical and turn-based, featuring grid-based movement and a strong emphasis on utilizing abilities.

-Use flanking and backstabs to increase damage.

-Gain experience, level up your team, choose new skills, and upgrade existing ones.

-Use crowd control abilities.

-Defeat bosses and complete special tasks to unlock more hellspawn.

store_data.about_the_game:
🏙️ BUILD YOUR OWN SKYSCRAPER


Start with a small building and develop it floor by floor into a massive skyscraper.

Plan the layout, decide on the use of each floor and combine apartments, offices, shops, leisure facilities and hotels into a functioning building complex.

You decide how your tower grows and what story it tells.

🛗 PLAN EFFICIENT TRAFFIC ROUTES


Thousands of residents, office workers, visitors and hotel guests need to reach their destinations reliably every day.

Plan elevators, stairs, entrances and lobbies so that people can move through your tower quickly and without long waiting times.

Prevent overcrowded areas, identify bottlenecks and adapt the traffic routes to the growth of your building.

🍽️ FULFILL PEOPLE'S NEEDS


Every group of people in your tower has their own requirements.

Residents want to live comfortably, office workers need a functioning work environment, visitors look for shopping and entertainment, while hotel guests place particular value on service and comfort.

Set up suitable facilities and services:

  • Snack bars and restaurants
  • Shops and service providers
  • Cinemas and leisure facilities
  • Ballrooms and event spaces
  • Further amenities for daily needs

Make sure that the right services are available in the right place and that the needs of all groups of people are met.

Only when residents, office workers, visitors and hotel guests feel comfortable can your tower be successful in the long term.

🏨 BUILD AND ORGANIZE YOUR OWN HOTEL


Integrate a hotel into your skyscraper and ensure smooth operations.

Plan hotel rooms, receptions, restaurants and other service areas. Make sure your guests can check in quickly, reach their rooms and are well looked after during their stay.

A well-organized hotel brings new visitors and additional revenue to your tower.

🗑️ ENSURE CLEANLINESS IN THE TOWER


Where many people live and work, a large amount of waste is produced every day.

Plan an efficient waste management system, organize disposal and prevent garbage from piling up in your building.

Place waste collection points sensibly, optimize transport routes and ensure that apartments, offices, restaurants and public areas remain clean.

A clean tower increases the satisfaction of its residents, employees, guests and visitors.

🚨 ENSURE SECURITY IN THE TOWER


The larger your building becomes, the more important security and organization become.

Set up security centers, employ suitable personnel and respond to disruptions and unexpected events.

Monitor critical areas and ensure that residents, guests, visitors and employees are protected at all times.

📊 KEEP AN EYE ON YOUR BALANCE SHEETS


Every new floor and every facility incurs costs.

Monitor your income and expenses, plan investments and decide when the right time for the next expansion has come.

  • Manage rental income and operating costs
  • Invest in new floors and facilities
  • Optimize unprofitable areas
  • Develop your tower into a successful business

Build smart, fulfill people's needs and create a skyscraper that never stands still.

YOUR TOWER. YOUR DECISIONS. YOUR STORY.

store_data.about_the_game:
Concept

In each game you receive a pool of random tiles that you should place on a blank board to create a map. Every tile can be rotated freely and contains a random arrangement of mountains, forests, meadows, swamps, water, buildings, or settlements.

Each settlement gathers resources from its own buildings and from surrounding terrain: fields provide food, mountains provide production, and water provides both food and gold. Settlements also collect resources from buildings, animals, and ships connected to them via roads, rivers, or coastlines.

Food allows a settlement to grow by adding new buildings. Production allows upgrades to existing buildings. Gold goes into a general pool. Each settlement also has a range that determines how far its influence extends. Different buildings have different construction costs and produce different resources. The entire process of growth and upgrading is automated in the basic version of the game.

Drawing

Terrain tiles are placed on a hex‑based grid. In addition, you can freely draw individual mountains, forests, trees, meadows, swamps, buildings, settlements, animals, water segments, roads, rivers, or labels anywhere on the map. Every drawing has a gold cost. Almost all map elements are animated to imitate the process of hand‑drawing - the entire map gradually appears before your eyes in real time.

Folks (Races)

The game will feature 23 playable folks (races or species). Each will have its own map frame, emblem, and unique graphics for all buildings. Each folk will also have special buildings that provide unique resources or functions. They also have special traits (for example, Dwarves gain extra gold from mountains and have a production bonus) and their own sets of prefixes and suffixes for generating names of villages, cities, mountain ranges, etc.

States (Countries)

You can place one or more states on the map, in any color. A state may consist of a single folk, but multiple folks can coexist within it. Likewise, each settlement may contain several ethnic minorities alongside its main people.

In addition to basic resources, settlements also generate strength, produced for example by castles and watchtowers. Strength influences state borders and contributes to conquests - the takeover of settlements from one state by another.

Experience

In the game, you earn experience, levels, and ranks. Experience comes from completing a map as well as from fulfilling tasks during its creation. These tasks may ask you to draw, for example, a forest of a certain size, a settlement with a specific population, or a state of a particular area.

Tasks have levels - higher levels demand more but grant better rewards. Rewards include extra experience, tiles, gold, or drawings. In the basic version of the game you start with only one people and a few basic drawings (mountains, water segments, buildings). Everything else is unlocked gradually by completing tasks on new maps. New folks are also unlocked as high‑level task rewards.

Current Progress

At the moment I have completed 5 out of 23 planned folks:
• Albins - humans inspired by Medieval Europe
• Erabs - humans inspired by Greek, Persian, and Arabian cultures
• Barbarians - humans inspired by Norse and Scottish traditions
• Jin-Hans - humans inspired by Mongolian, Chinese and Japanese cultures
• Enuits - humans inspired by Inuit culture
The remaining 18 are waiting - including dwarves, elves, halflings, orcs, and many more.

Many planned features are already functional, while several modes and systems are still in development. I'm currently working on the Steam video trailer and a climate system that affects the appearance and resources of forests and fields.

I don't have a release date yet, but I plan to launch the first playable version once the game reaches 10–12 folks. Additional folks will be added later as free updates, and I don't intend to release them as paid DLC. There will also be no microtransactions in the game.

store_data.about_the_game:
The Tale of THE DARK

Follow Addie, a teenage girl who get dragged down into an alternate realm, THE DARK, by it's exiled prince, Dexter. The two of them must traverse the land, running into different interesting people, to reach the capital and take back the crown. 

What to expect in this tale?

  • A battle system largely inspired by the system common in RPG Maker titles, as well as older RPGs from the 90's

  • Reaction based attacks that you must dodge or deflect, like a playful pounce or a FREAKING CANNONBALL!!!

  • A fairly linear adventure, focused on dialouge and puzzle solving.

  • Interesting characters like a drunk cat.

  • Did I mention the dogs.

  • The whole game made by (mostly) one creature.

This is normally the part where I thank you for reading this description.

If you want to, you can try out the free demo that contains the first chapter. Then once you've tried the game, you can grab the rest. 

Um.... that's all I have to say

have fun ;)
